title: Head of Brand
description:
**About Click\&Boat**
---------------------


Click\&Boat is a rental platform product of Boats Group, the fastest\-growing digital business in the recreational boating space. We are a talented team of techies, creatives, marketers, closers and customer advocates who spend each day pushing the boundaries of technology to make buying, selling \& renting boats easy.


Click\&Boat is the European leader in boat rentals, with over €170M in annual GMV and a community of 2\.4M\+ registered users across 150\+ countries worldwide. Our marketplace makes boating accessible around the globe, from a day trip to a week\-long adventure, while enabling private and professional boat owners to generate additional income through rentals.


Performance marketing and SEO have been central to our growth. We are now investing in the next source of advantage: making Click\&Boat the brand travellers know, trust and actively seek out before they reach their destination.


A large share of boat rental still happens offline, locally and at the last minute. Our opportunity is to bring more of that demand online and encourage travellers to discover, plan and book their boating experience earlier. A fresh rebranding was performed in 2025, and the next challenge is now to build familiarity, trust and category authority at greater scale \- particularly for families, skippered rentals, multi\-day experiences and other higher\-consideration occasions.


To fuel this next phase of growth, we're hiring a Head of Brand \& Content to lead our brand strategy and build Click\&Boat into the most trusted and top\-of\-mind digital destination for boat rental, based in our Barcelona office.

**The role**
------------


We're looking for a Head of Brand \& Content to join our crew in Barcelona and lead a creative, highly motivated brand function with a solid leadership foundation. While driven by commercial impact, this is a strategic 360° brand position \- not an operational SEO or pure content role. It combines long\-term brand strategy, 360° activations (field/IRL, PR, social, brand partnerships) and multi\-channel orchestration to drive top\-of\-mind awareness and generate measurable unpaid demand.


Reporting directly to the General Manager of Click\&Boat, you will lead a team of 7 (4 permanent positions and 3 interns/apprentices) covering Digital Campaigns, Partnerships, Social Media, Influence, PR, and Content.


As a long\-term strategic leader, your role is to guide, frame, and validate the overall brand roadmap, while empowering your team of specialists to own day\-to\-day execution. You will manage a meaningful annual budget across campaigns, production, selective media, PR, partnerships, research and specialist support, and work in close, day\-to\-day collaboration with SEO, Product, Operations and Performance Marketing to accelerate Click\&Boat's unpaid growth across multiple geographies.

**What floats your boat**
-------------------------

* Continuously build Click\&Boat's top\-of\-mind awareness and brand preference to establish the company as the undisputed, go\-to destination for boat rentals across target markets, so that brand fame naturally converts into a top\-of\-mind purchasing reflex for any boating occasion.
* Make Click\&Boat synonymous with an easy, flexible and trusted way to rent a boat online, and broaden how customers think about the brand beyond casual day rentals, including family, skippered, multi\-day and higher\-value experiences.
* Set the creative vision for our annual flagship initiatives (e.g., Summer Campaign) and orchestrate high\-impact 360° activations across digital, field/IRL, PR, and brand partnerships to grow brand awareness and consideration.
* Define the creative framework for content and ensure it resonates across our channels, in partnership with Product, SEO, and CRM, who lead execution and leverage reviews, customer stories, and owner expertise to build category trust.
* Ensure content strategy (social media, blog/SEO) stays aligned with the overall brand strategy, in partnership with the respective channel owners.
* Earn relevant attention and third\-party validation, prioritising initiatives that strengthen reputation, direct demand or organic authority.
* Partner with the SEO team on editorial priorities and authority\-building, while SEO retains ownership of the organic channel, technical strategy and performance.
* Experiment with emerging discovery behaviours, including how Click\&Boat is represented and recommended by AI assistants and answer engines, with an approach that is globally coherent and locally effective across priority traveller markets.
* Lead, coach and develop a multidisciplinary team of 7, setting clear priorities and a culture of curiosity, accountability and experimentation, while overseeing external agencies, production partners, creators and technology providers.
* Own Click\&Boat's tone of voice and brand guidelines, helping Product and Operations apply it consistently across renter and owner communications.
* Represent the customer and the brand in senior commercial and product discussions, without losing sight of delivery constraints and return on investment.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------


In your first 12 months, you will have:

* Established clear market baselines for trust, mental availability, branded demand and unpaid bookings.
* Aligned content, social, PR and partnerships behind a single strategy and prioritised roadmap.
* Developed and activated a distinctive, trust\-building creative platform across priority markets.
* Launched measurable initiatives that encourage travellers to discover and book before arriving at their destination.
* Created a credible evidence base showing which brand and content investments can be scaled.

**What you bring aboard**
-------------------------

* 8\+ years of experience across consumer brand, content or integrated marketing, ideally in a digital marketplace, travel, e\-commerce or consumer technology business.
* A track record of building or scaling a consumer brand across multiple geographies.
* Experience turning brand strategy into a distinctive creative platform, campaigns and always\-on content \- not simply managing isolated assets.
* Evidence that your work influenced customer acquisition, direct demand, conversion, market share or another meaningful commercial outcome.
* Strong creative judgement combined with analytical discipline and confident budget prioritisation.
* Experience leading a lean, multidisciplinary team and managing agencies or specialist partners.
* Enough understanding of SEO, digital distribution and AI\-assisted discovery to collaborate credibly with specialists, without needing to be a technical SEO practitioner.
* The ability to influence Product and Operations through customer evidence, clear business cases and pragmatic prioritisation.
* Full proficiency in English is required.

**Bonus points (great to have, never a dealbreaker)**

* Experience working in the US market.
* Fluent in French, Spanish or German.
* Experience in travel, marketplaces, e\-commerce or another low\-frequency, high\-consideration category.
* Experience with brand lift, incrementality testing, marketing\-mix analysis or other approaches to measuring brand investment.
* Experience launching video, creator, community or AI\-discovery programmes.

**How we work**
---------------


This role reports directly to the General Manager so that Brand has the access and organisational weight to influence Click\&Boat's growth agenda. That influence is earned through evidence, prioritisation and delivery. Product owns its roadmap, SEO owns the organic channel, and Operations owns the customer and owner processes; you will help these teams express one coherent, trusted Click\&Boat brand.

**️ The hiring journey**
------------------------

* HR conversation with our Head of Talent Acquisition
* Manager interview with Christian Berces, General Manager
* Collaboration interview 1 with our CPTO
* Collaboration interview 2 with a Brand Manager
* Final validation with senior People and Business leadership


We aim to keep things smooth, transparent, and respectful of your time throughout the process.

**What awaits you aboard**
--------------------------

* Real strategic scope: shape how Click\&Boat grows its brand and unpaid demand across international markets.
* 23 days of paid leave.
* 10 extra days off (CAB days).
* Restaurant tickets: €3\.50 per worked day, 100% paid by CAB.
* Flexible retribution.
* Wellhub (sport \& wellbeing discounts).
* Hybrid working arrangement: office Monday to Thursday, remote on Fridays.
* Boat licence: \-40% via partnerships.
* Boat hire vouchers for friends \& family, no commission when you're on board, 50% commission for your immediate family.
* Free bike parking, and discounted car parking.


Contract: Full\-time, permanent.


Team: 7 direct/indirect reports (4 permanent, 3 interns/apprentices).

**Ready to come aboard?**
-------------------------


If this opportunity sounds like your next adventure, hit "apply to this job"


At Click\&Boat, every application is reviewed with equal care and attention, regardless of age, gender, origin, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We hire for talent.

description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are looking for a highly systematic **Senior Creative Producer** to own the ad creative engine for one of our core D2C subscription products in the consumer AI category. You will be fully responsible for the full concept\-to\-performance loop, generating the angles, driving production volume, running structured tests, performing competitor research, and turning creative\-level data into the next round of winning concepts.


This is a high\-impact role. Your ad creatives will be the primary performance lever: your work moves CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS directly, and you are accountable for those numbers alongside the User Acquisition team. The bar is high and so is the upside; performance here is directly and significantly rewarded.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Creative Strategy \& Concepting**


	+ Own the creative angle strategy: Define which hooks, pains, and value propositions get tested next
	+ Develop creative concepts: demo\-led ads, UGC\-style video, statics, and AI\-generated formats
	+ Translate product features and capabilities into concrete, scroll\-stopping propositions for target audiences
	+ Build and maintain a documented library of proven angles, hooks, and creative patterns### **Production \& Testing Velocity**


	+ Own the creative pipeline across ad networks (Google, YouTube, Meta, Snapchat, TikTok, Applovin, etc) shipping new concepts every week
	+ Structure systematic A/B testing frameworks, isolate variables, and analyze the results to bring solid conclusions.
	+ Produce clear creative briefs for designers to execute high\-performing concepts aligned with the brand.### **Performance Analysis \& Iteration**


	+ Own creative\-level metrics: hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CVR, CPA, and ROAS
	+ Generate testable hypotheses from performance data and retire underperforming angles quickly
	+ Identify winning patterns, codify why they work, and scale them into new concept batches
	+ Deliver structured creative performance reviews with clear recommendations for the next cycle### **Market Research \& Collaboration**


	+ Run systematic competitor creative research across ad libraries and creative intelligence tools
	+ Track emerging formats, platform policy shifts, and creative trends in the consumer AI category
	+ Communicate daily with User Acquisition Managers, taking briefs on which angles need more volume

**Qualifications**
==================

**Must\-Have Experience**

* **4\+ years** producing performance ad creative for D2C or subscription consumer products
* Proven track record of **high\-volume output**, shipping and live\-testing multiple new concepts weekly
* Deep working knowledge of the major ad network ecosystems (**Google, Meta, TikTok, Snapchat**, etc).
* **Demonstrated fluency with an AI production** stack across image, video, voice, and scripting tools
* Ability to read creative\-level performance data independently and act on it without an analyst in the loop
* Experience building structured creative testing frameworks, not ad\-hoc one\-off tests
* **Strong portfolio** of ads with verifiable performance results. (Applications must include a CV and a portfolio of ad creative you personally produced).

**Leadership Attributes**

* Systematic operator. You build repeatable creative processes, not one\-time wins
* Fully accountable for performance outcomes, not just delivery of assets
* Fast and decisive under volume. Comfortable killing your own concepts when data says so
* Treats User Acquisition as a working partner, not a downstream recipient of files

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab\=t.0\#heading\=h.ndsdl4wapxtt


Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================


After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Take\-Home Assignment
* First Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (40 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================


At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.


This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.


Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

Art Director, Clash of Clans
description:
**Clash of Clans is one of the most recognisable games ever made. We want to keep it that way, and then some.**
 Clash is growing beyond the game, showing up in trailers, campaigns, toys, and collaborations. The visual identity has to stretch to cover all of it, stay true to what players love, and still feel fresh. We're also modernising how we make things: pipelines are evolving, our content production is scaling, and we're working more closely with external partners than ever before.
   

  

 We need someone who can own this at a strategic level. Someone who sets the vision, builds the conditions for great work, and steers the IP with confidence across every surface it touches.
   

  

 What You'll Be Doing
   

  

* Define and evolve the visual direction of Clash across the game, cosmetics, and wherever else the IP lives. True to its DNA, but never frozen in time.
* Set the standard for style and brand fit across in\-game art, marketing, trailers, toy lines, campaigns, and entertainment partners, and empower the team to uphold it.
* Partner with game design, product, and marketing leadership to ensure art strategy supports gameplay clarity, player understanding, and long\-term brand health.
* Mentor and support Clash artists, help them do the best work of their careers while staying aligned on the IP.
* Shape the roadmap for modernising Clash pipelines (2D to 3D, audio, tooling, and emerging technologies), championing approaches that give artists more time for the work only they can do.
* Represent art at a senior level across the business: outsourcing partners, Entertainment and Partnerships, marketing, and franchise collaborators.


 What You Have
   

  

* A strong track record leading art direction on stylised games. Mobile and live\-service experience is a big plus.
* Deep IP and brand instincts, the ability to define what's on\-brand vs off and build the frameworks that help a whole team make that call consistently.
* Leadership experience on a highly collaborative senior art teams: setting vision, developing artists, and making the culture as strong as the output.
* Strategic experience managing outsourcing pipelines and external partners at scale, balancing quality ambitions with the realities of live\-game timelines and budgets.
* Comfort operating in a low\-process, high\-trust environment where you own the outcomes, not just the opinions.
* A self\-starter approach to use AI. You've found ways to use it in your day\-to\-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.


 Would Be Nice if You Also Have
   

  

* Experience with cosmetics economies or large seasonal content pipelines.
* Experience bridging game art strategy and marketing/UA: key art, trailers, social.
* Familiarity with Clash (as a player or from prior work) and a feel for how it's evolved.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

 This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. Clash of Clans team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios however most of our Artists are located in Helsinki!
   

  

 To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role especially if based out of London.
   

  

 –––
   

  

*That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.*
*Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.*
*–––*
**About Supercell**
 Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of
 *Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars* 
 . Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.
   

  

 So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.
   

  

 Hey, You Might Love It Here!
   

  

 Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.
   

  

 You Are Not Your Job Title ™
   

  

 Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.
   

  

**Benefits And Compensation**
 Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.
   

  

 Relocation? Yes!
   

  

 No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!
   

  

 Not Sure if You Should Apply?
   

  

 Many candidates with great skills and experience second\-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.
   

  

 Wishing you all the best,
   

  

 The Supercell Recruitment team

title: Head of Design, AI-First
description:
**Own the design function for a $1Billion\+ brand. Transform how we build with AI.** 




  





**Total Annual Package:** 
 Up to USD $181,500 \+ comprehensive benefits (Base salary \+ monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)
 



**Location:** 
 Remote (Global)
 



**Growth path** 
 from here is VP Design → Chief Design Officer. What takes 4\-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1\-2 years here for high performers.
 



  





**We've been AI\-first since December 2023:** 
 Every design proposal ships with an AI review link, and Figma AI runs in our live production pipeline, shipping real work. You'd start where most teams are still trying to get.
 



  





*This position is remote, with the option to work from our Dubai office (with 0% income tax), if preferred (relocation and visa sponsorship support available).* 




  





**Role Overview** 




 Puffy, a market\-leading, nine\-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1 billion in sales, is hiring a Head of Design to turn our end\-to\-end web design from a sequential production queue into a fast, AI\-native operation. You will build on our existing AI adoption by establishing consistent workflows, prompt infrastructure, quality controls and system governance that let high\-quality design work ship at volume without extending timelines. While you own the visual and structural execution of the site, you will partner closely with the CRO team, which owns experimentation, including test hypotheses and the conversion roadmap.
 



  





**The Career Accelerator** 




 You will have the rare opportunity to take on a broad scope of work with unmatched autonomy.
 



  




* **The scope is scarce:** 
 very few Heads of Design get simultaneous ownership over the design system, the AI toolchain, the design roadmap and accessibility standards while leading a team of three as a hands\-on player coach and reporting directly to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion. This is not a role where you just review other people's mockups and forward them to engineering. Instead, you are building the operating system for the entire design function.
* **Your first 12 months:** 
 rebuild the design workflow from sequential to agile, with kickoff huddles and a 40% reduction in time from design concept to development handoff. Build the prompt library and review workflow covering product copy, FAQs, size/fit guidance, policy explainers, and localized variants. Design the UI patterns for conversational search, guided finders, and PDP Q\&A alongside engineering. Own the recommendation surfaces — placements, card density, "why this" microcopy — and validate them with staged rollouts. Evolve the design system so tokens and components absorb AI\-generated variants without brand drift or PageSpeed cost. Bake WCAG 2\.2 into the system and pair AI\-assisted audits with manual review. Feed the experimentation roadmap with design variants that the CRO team can test at pace, and turn winning patterns into reusable standards across the design system. Shape the future of design at Puffy, where the site is the entire storefront and every conversion point runs through your team.



  





**What Is In It For You** 




 This isn't just another design management role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.
 



  





**1\. Own the Design Function and the Toolchain It Runs On** 




 You set the standard, build the workflow, and own what ships.
 


* You design the operating model for the whole function: how work enters the queue, how AI\-generated variants get validated, where human QA sits, and how a spec reaches Dev Mode without losing intent. You own IA, wireframes, high\-fidelity comps, prototypes, and motion specs across Home, PLP, PDP, Cart/Checkout, editorial, and paid\-media landing pages. You decide what the design system tolerates and what it rejects.
* You hold the line on WCAG 2\.2, PageSpeed, and brand consistency while the volume goes up. You’re accountable for design quality, delivery speed, and the design team's contribution to conversion lift. You report to the VP, Digital Experience \& Conversion, present quarterly design roadmap reviews and translate design decisions \& experiment results into a narrative that the business acts on.



  





**2\. Join a High\-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:** 




 🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1 Billion USD in Sales
 



 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
 



 💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high\-velocity execution that drives a global brand
 



  





**3\. Embrace Radical Flexibility** 




 Work from anywhere in the world with meaningful time zone overlap. Structure your environment around your best thinking, whether that's a home office, a co\-working space or our Dubai headquarters (with full relocation, visa support, and 0% income tax if you choose). Your output is your credential, not your location.
 



  





**4\. Become the Design Leader Other Brands Come Looking For** 




 In most companies, design leaders inherit a workflow somebody else built and spend their tenure defending its timelines in meetings. Here you build it. When the CEO decides what ships next quarter, your design roadmap is the input to that decision, not a status report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an AI\-native design operation you designed end to end — and the handoff\-time and conversion numbers proving quality held while volume went up, which is the part almost nobody in this function can actually show. Puffy has been AI\-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI\-native toolbox behind you rather than a versioning queue in front of you.
 



  





**What You'll Need** 



* 7\+ years in web design for e\-commerce, including 4\+ years leading, mentoring, and managing the operations of a design team.
* A portfolio that shows shipped PDP/PLP/Checkout improvements tied to clear business metrics.
* Expert in Figma (components, variables, Dev Mode); strong visual/motion craft and responsive design sensibility.
* Proven experience implementing GenAI tools into a professional design pipeline, with a clear understanding of prompt engineering, quality control, and brand governance.
* Familiarity with AI\-shaped UX patterns: conversational search, assistant UI, recommendation modules, and their measurement.
* Comfort collaborating on experiments (A/B vs multi\-armed bandits) with the CRO team; understands trade\-offs between optimization speed and causal certainty.
* Working knowledge of WCAG 2\.2 and SEO fundamentals for structured content and schema on e\-commerce sites.



  





**Good\-to\-Have** 



* Experience designing chat or guided\-selling flows



  





**The Puffy DNA:** 




 We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast\-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.
 


* **Be the Owner:** 
 We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* **Execute with Urgency:** 
 We thrive in high\-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* **Demand Excellence:** 
 We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* **Be AI\-First:** 
 Daily multi\-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* **Go All\-In:**

title: Creative Director
description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico \& Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House \& Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.
   

  

**Job Description**
 Location:
   

  

 London, GB
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company, home to iconic brands including Vogue, GQ, Glamour, CN Traveller, Vanity Fair, Wired, The World of Interiors, House \& Garden and Tatler, among many others.
   

  

 We are headquartered in New York and London and operate in 32 markets worldwide, with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers across print, digital, video and social platforms.
   

  

 Condé Nast thrives on collaboration, and our teams come together in the office four days a week (Monday \- Thursday).
   

  

 We value diversity of background, views and cultures. We celebrate people for their personal qualities, skills and contributions, recognising the power our brands have to influence and shape culture.
   

  

 Condé Nast is a global media company producing the highest quality content with a footprint of more than 1 billion consumers in 32 territories through print, digital, video and social platforms. The company’s portfolio includes many of the world’s most respected and influential media properties including Vogue, Vanity Fair, Glamour, Self, GQ, The New Yorker, Condé Nast Traveler/Traveller, Allure, AD, Bon Appétit and Wired, among others.
   

  

 Based in our London office, this role helps to set the creative vision and leads the overarching delivery of global and UK branded content, advertiser partnerships, and brand marketing across Condé Nast’s editorial portfolio. As a culturally attuned, conceptual leader, you will drive 360° creative strategy that connects brands to culture at scale. You bring a track record of editorially inspired work, natural mentorship, and the capability to deputise for the Executive Creative Director—aiding in guiding the department vision, setting creative standards, and inspiring the wider team.
   

  

 Reporting to the Executive Creative Director, you will partner with senior marketing, strategy, and sales leaders to shape major commercial opportunities, pitch transformative partnership ideas, and oversee cross\-departmental execution with editorial teams. Success requires visionary storytelling, deep commercial strategy, and a sharp cultural perspective. The Creative Director oversees overall portfolio output, establishing the creative direction and directing senior talent on high\-stakes, multi\-platform briefs—from global luxury video campaigns to multi\-market event sponsorships.
   

  

 You excel at guiding cross\-functional teams through complex, fast\-paced workflows, bringing executive\-level problem\-solving and strategic clarity to every meeting. The ideal candidate ensures creative excellence while safeguarding Condé Nast’s brand authority, creative standards, and journalistic integrity across all commercial initiatives.
   

  

 Individual \& Team Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop bold multi\-channel creative work that reflects the voice and ethos of all Condé Nast titles for advertisers across categories.
* Assign, collaborate with and direct the work of multi\-disciplinary creatives suitable for each project (art directors, designers, etc).
* Apply strategic insights in order to craft inventive content, experiential solutions, and partnership ideas that align with audience data, brand ethos, and client objectives.
* Direct video and photo shoots with a focus on performance and editorial quality.
* Serve as the primary creative client liaison on campaigns—presenting work, managing feedback, and guiding creative integrity across production.
* Drive brainstorms and work hands\-on when crafting proposals and presentations.
* Propose creative solutions that fit within the provided budgets.
* Ensure all commercial ideas authentically balance the voices and perspectives of our editorial brands with those of our advertising partners.
* Help build a thriving creative department; nurture talent, establish workflow efficiencies, and champion inclusive, forward\-thinking creative culture.
* Deputise for the Executive Creative Director across key business forums, internal leadership meetings, and executive client pitches.


**Essential Skills \& Requirements**
* 10\+ years of experience as a creative lead in premium media or agency environments.
* A demonstrated appreciation for the subject matter and creativity of the brands you’ll represent at Condé Nast.
* Confidence working with and directing artists, experts, celebrities and creators as talent on commercial projects.
* Strong portfolio showcasing work across print, digital, video and events.
* Passion for brand marketing, with a sharp cultural perspective that informs consumer\-facing campaigns.
* Skilled storyteller with excellent written, visual, and verbal presentation abilities.
* Extensive on\-set experience and deep knowledge of video and photography production, from pre\- to post\-production (for digital and print).
* Demonstrated success managing creative teams and working within established systems to improve output and efficiency.
* A creative aesthetic emphasizing current standards in entertainment, fashion, luxury and design.
* Highly organized, adaptable and adept at prioritizing workloads in fast\-paced environments.
* Ability to work fluently with collaborators in production \- writers, DPs, photographers, editors, animators, and designers.
* Proficiency in Google Slides and treatment deck creation. Bonus: familiarity with Adobe Creative Suite and editing software.


**Desired Qualities**
* Culturally informed \- Current on music and entertainment, luxury and fashion, as well as knowledgeable about Condé Nast brands and culture. Additionally, have awareness of relevant artists, and creative vendors.
* Highly imaginative \- You’re a conceptual creative with innovative ideas that challenge outdated approaches to content and the definition of “experiential.”
* Detail\-oriented \- Equally obsessed with creating memorable work and impactful campaigns that solve our client’s challenges.
* Agile and adaptable \- Open to taking input from others and willing to take on essential tasks needed to get the job done.
* Think critically \- You strive to come up with ideas that solve brand challenges, can manage multiple projects at once, and know when to pivot if something isn’t working.
* Have an ego\-less attitude \- You give credit where credit is due, bring a positive attitude to work and support your teammates in gaining visibility and opportunities.
* A natural mentor \- You prioritize diversity, inclusivity, and representation in every stage of the creative process and empathy in team collaboration.


 What benefits do we offer?
   

  

* 25 days holiday (plus bank holidays) and extra days of annual leave if you move house or want to volunteer.
* You’ll have access to a competitive pension scheme, Bupa Private Healthcare, Season ticket loans and eye tests.

* Our Employee Resource Groups provide a platform for employees to identify shared objectives, exchange ideas, and work on community priorities for our global workforce.

Your work will directly influence player experience, the desirability of cosmetic content and the long\-term visual strategy of one of the world's most established MMORPGs.

* Partner with the Creative, Development and Product Directors, aligning artistic priorities with gameplay goals, production requirements and the wider Road to Restoration.
* Work closely with Technical Art and Engineering, improving pipelines, tools and workflows while balancing creative ambition with the technical realities of a live game across PC and mobile.
* Champion accessibility, readability and player experience, ensuring visual decisions support clear gameplay and remain effective across platforms.
* Represent the art discipline across RuneScape and the wider studio, contributing to recruitment, talent development and the game's long\-term creative strategy.


**What we're looking for:**
* Significant, demonstrable experience in Art Direction or senior art leadership within the games industry, gained on shipped or live titles.
* A proven track record of taking artistic direction from initial vision through to in\-game execution, balancing creative ambition with live\-service schedules, technical limitations and production realities.
* Proven experience leading a sizeable multidisciplinary art team, including managing performance, developing artists and navigating structural or organisational change.
* A strong professional background directing stylised or stylised\-realistic 3D art, supported by demonstrable knowledge of 3D pipelines, production tools, optimisation and technical constraints.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating artistic vision, visual problem\-solving and the ability to establish a consistent quality bar across multiple art disciplines.

**About Jagex**
 We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company. Home to one of gaming's most enduring success stories. We create deep, community\-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape, has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.
   

  

 As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025, representing a major step in building a multi\-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player\-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape's history. For more information, visit https://www.jagex.com/ .

We're looking for people to join us who share our ambitions and values. We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences that inspire our communities.

We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers' Heroes by striving to understand our team \& player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.

title: Creative Director
description:
**About Engine**
 Engine is the all\-in\-one travel and spend management platform trusted by 38K\+ businesses and groups representing 1\.8M\+ travelers. We're the retailer and the rails of business travel, one of the fastest\-growing companies in travel tech, built on a decade of proprietary technology, supply, and pricing no one else can replicate. Other travel and AI companies run on our infrastructure to book real trips, hold rates, and move payments, without building any of it themselves. We built it, AI\-forward at every layer, from how travelers book to how the rails run.
   

  

 That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025\), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026\), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026\).
   

  

 We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high\-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.
   

  

 Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.
   

  

**Your Mission**
 Create across the entire customer journey. Growth touches every stage from the first impression in a paid ad, printed asset, or event through the website, lifecycle, in\-product moments, and beyond.
   

  

 You'll own the creative that shows up across all of it and build the automation, tooling, and workflows behind a creative engine capable of producing distinctive, high\-performing, on\-brand work at scale. You'll make AI a core part of how we create while maintaining a high bar for taste, craft, and originality.
   

  

 This is a role for a creative leader who wants to
 **build as much as they lead** 
 shaping the work, the systems, and ultimately the team behind it.
   

  

**What You'll Own**
* **The AI\-assisted creative engine.** 
 Design the end\-to\-end creative pipeline: workflows, prompt libraries, components, guardrails, asset databases, and tool stacks that allow us to ship high volumes of quality creative quickly. Drive real innovation in how we apply AI to stand out, and establish the QA systems that keep quality high as output scales.
* **New tools and approaches to creative production.** 
 Continuously experiment with emerging creative technology, agencies, and production models. Partner with Growth's technical resources to leverage open\-source libraries and build new capabilities that increase the speed, quality, and scale of creative production.
* **Creative as targeting.** 
 Treat creative as an audience filter and a growth lever. Build frameworks for high\-performing creative territories, connect testing insights and customer behavior to new ideas, and diagnose what's working through signals like hook rate, hold rate, conversion, and creative decay.
* **The bridge between brand and scale.** 
 Work closely with Engine's Brand team to translate creative and narrative into Engine's brand systems while finding new ways to scale performance without losing what makes the brand distinctive.
* **In\-person and experiential creative.** 
 Lead creative for events, conferences, activations, and field moments. Design experiences that make the brand felt, earn attention in the room, and create stories and assets that travel far beyond the event itself.
* **Brand\-distinctive, entertainment\-first work.** 
 Ship creative that earns its media spend: bold, memorable, and unmistakably Engine. Bring flagship ideas that break category conventions while keeping the creative pipeline fresh ahead of fatigue.
* **Testing velocity.** 
 Partner with Growth on structured testing frameworks, concept logs, and learning agendas so every cycle compounds into smarter, stronger creative.
* **The creative team.** 
 Lead and develop designers, editors, AI specialists, and producers. Set the creative bar, stay close to the work, and deploy your own craft when it counts. Build a culture that values experimentation, speed, accountability, and exceptional creative standards.


**How We'll Measure Success**
 Leading indicators include testing velocity, volume of test\-ready assets shipped, creative performance signals such as hook rate and hold rate, and reach generated from in\-person moments.
   

  

 Lagging indicators include efficient acquisition and pipeline driven by creative and events, with creative quality and brand fit maintained as output scales.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* Extensive experience in creative strategy or creative leadership, with a track record of innovation and measurable business impact.
* A portfolio that spans both experiential or event creative and performance\-driven digital work.
* Hands\-on fluency with generative AI and creative technology including tools like: Midjourney, Runway, Firefly, ElevenLabs, automation platforms and the ability to turn them into scalable creative systems.
* Strong direct\-response instincts: you can diagnose hooks, understand why creative performs, and know what makes work effective platform by platform.
* A systems\-builder mindset. You naturally think in workflows, SOPs, pipelines, and ways to increase creative velocity without compromising quality.
* Craft pedigree in copy, art direction, design, or video that grounds your strategic judgment.
* Strong performance fluency: you're comfortable with the metrics and know how to translate data and creative signals into the next iteration.
* Experience leading and developing creative talent while remaining close enough to the work to contribute directly when needed.
* Visionary and pragmatic, with high agency and an appetite for building in a fast\-moving, AI\-forward environment.


*We accept applications for this role on an ongoing basis. We review applications as they are received and encourage interested candidates to apply early.*
**Compensation**
 Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.
   

  

 Base Pay Range
   

  

 $157,505—$218,000 USD
   

  

**The Engine Edge: Perks \& Compensation**
 We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:
   

  

* **Compensation:**

* **Benefits:** 
 Check out our full list at engine.com/culture
* **Environments for Success:**

title: Performance Creative Director
description:
**KittySpout / DoggySpout** 
 is looking for a
 **Performance Creative Strategist** 
 to join our team! As our creative strategist, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a heavy focus on Meta VSLs, UGC ads, and high\-converting direct response ads \- short and long form \- that scale across our paid channels. We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta. We are looking to hire someone with 3\+ years of experience. The ideal candidate has deep DTC experience in performance creative, runs a current AI stack in production, has experience briefing short and long form VSLs and delivers volume and quality in the same week, without being chased.
   

  

**Who are we?**
 KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters, and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon, and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest\-growing brands in the pet space — $22M\+ in revenue and targeting $45\-50M in 2026\. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're lean, we move fast, and every person on this team has a massive impact on the business.
   

  

**What is our culture like \& who is a good fit?**
 Culture\-fit is our \#1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will\-to\-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less \- and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king, and better everyday. We love learning \- every problem is an opportunity to grow.
   

  

**If you want a stress\-free corporate 9\-5 job, this isn't it.**
 If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast\-growing company, work directly with the founders, and see huge career growth by playing a big role in scaling it to $100m\+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, work in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, and play a big part in our growth being hands\-on and active, all while having a generous performance bonus structure — then you've come to the right place.
   

  

**Key Objectives:**
* Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis
* Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives
* Script Direct response creatives
* Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives
* Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas
* Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
* Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
* Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative
* Produce a minimum of 15 ad briefs per week, maintaining volume and quality simultaneously — without being chased


**Requirements**
* Fully remote
* Fluent in English
* Direct Response Expertise: 3\+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must
* Strong analytical skills with hands\-on experience interpreting performance data from platforms such as Northbeam, Facebook Ads, leveraging spreadsheets and reporting tools to extract insights, inform strategy and communicate campaign ideas and results
* No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn't know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work
* Excellent cultural fit as per our values above
* Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders
* Proven VSL copywriting experience on DR / performance brands
* Deep DTC Experience: You can name the brands and the spend levels behind your work — not just categories
* Meta VSLs: Proven experience with both short and long form Meta VSLs. Long form is the bulk of what we run
* AI Stack: You run a current AI stack in production — not one you tried once
* Output: You deliver volume and quality in the same week, without being chased
* Deep fluency with DTC and modern consumer brands


**Examples of What You'll Be Doing:**
* Develop VSL briefings end\-to\-end: angle, hook, script, structure
* Design AI\-driven concepts and hooks for paid video
* Partner with editors and performance marketers on testing
* Iterate strategy based on creative performance data


**How Our Hiring Works \& How We Operate:**
 We review applications on a rolling basis and keep strong candidates in our talent bench. If you're a great fit and the timing isn't right immediately, you'll be first in line when a spot opens. Our process has three stages:
   

  

* Application Review \+ Screening \- we assess your background and experience to confirm mutual fit
* Technical Interview \+ Creative Brief \- a short practical exercise so we can see how you think and work
* Culture Fit Interview \- a final conversation with the founder to make sure this is the right team for you and you're the right person for us


 KPIs and performance targets will be defined together before your start date so expectations are crystal clear from day one.
   

  

**Salary Expectation**
 USD $3,000 \- $6,000 per month base (based on experience and expertise) \+ percentage of ad spend bonus structure.
   

  

**We spend $2,000,000\+ per month on Meta only.**

title: Creative Director
description:
**Company Overview**

French Florist is a luxury floral brand redefining what it means to give and receive flowers, with a thriving e\-commerce business and a growing network of brick\-and\-mortar boutiques. Rooted in beauty, craft, and care, we operate and express ourselves in a more elevated, differentiated way than others in the category—from the quality of our blooms to the tone of every customer touchpoint. As French Florist scales across digital and physical channels, we are building a brand that feels unmistakably premium at every turn.

**Role Summary**

The Creative Director, Marketing leads campaign concepts, art direction, and day\-to\-day creative execution for French Florist’s Marketing team. This role turns the brand’s premium positioning into compelling campaigns, content, and sales materials, with clear ownership of the team’s work and routine creative approvals.

Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, this hands\-on leader manages the Marketing creative team, including the Production Designer, and produces work alongside them. The role partners with the VP of Brand, Experience \& Innovation, who owns company\-wide brand identity, standards, and experience direction. * Experience directing creative across both digital and physical / retail environments

**Skills \& Capabilities**

* Excellent collaborator across marketing, product, and operations

This is an opportunity to lead the Marketing creative team for a growing premium brand built on beauty, craft, and care. The Creative Director will have real ownership of campaign ideas, creative quality, and the team’s development, with a strong brand foundation and close cross\-functional partners to build from.

Benefits:

Work Location: Remote

title: Vice President, Creative Director, Copy

title: Creative Director
description:
**HCF’s Collaboration Philosophy**
==================================


At the Hawai‘i Community Foundation (HCF), we believe that an organization’s team as a ‘whole is greater than the sum of its parts’ (Aristotle). To us, this means that we are committed to being a collaborative ‘ohana that lives and puts our mission into action, respects and cares for each other, and innovates and learns together. We understand that we must rely upon all of our individual strengths as we partner to provide excellent value and achieve effective results for our generous donors, community partners, and all of Hawai‘i’s people.

**Position Summary**
====================


Like all HCF team members and volunteers, the Creative Director exudes heart and passion for HCF’s mission: to inspire the spirit of giving and invest in people and solutions to benefit our community.


The Creative Director is a senior creative leader who shapes and stewards HCF’s visual identity across platforms. As a hands\-on designer on a lean communications team, this role combines executive\-level creative direction with high\-caliber design execution, producing high\-visibility assets and setting standards for consistency, accessibility, and brand excellence.


Working in close partnership with the Strategic Communications Director, the Creative Director helps to co\-lead departmental priorities, coordinate workflow, allocate resources, and ensure alignment between communications strategies, creative execution, and organizational objectives. Together, these roles foster a collaborative, integrated communications approach that advances HCF’s mission, strengthens stakeholder engagement, and supports organizational goals.


In addition to providing design leadership, the Creative Director personally executes a significant volume of print, digital, and multimedia design work. The role serves as backup to the Multimedia Designer when that team member is unavailable or when additional production capacity is needed. The Creative Director also serves as project manager for creative projects, overseeing all aspects and phases of production through timely delivery.

**Essential Position Responsibilities**
=======================================


Key responsibilities fall within the following areas of focus.

**Creative Leadership, Collaboration and Management**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Lead creative projects from concept through delivery, overseeing ideation, planning, design, production, review, implementation, timelines, workflows, budgets, and evaluation.
* Develop and present creative briefs, concepts, frameworks, and presentations aligned with organizational goals, audience needs, and stakeholder requirements.
* Manage creative processes, systems, resources, and capacity planning to support effective project delivery across departments.
* Collaborate with staff, vendors, contractors, and external creative partners to complete projects from concept to completion.
* Partner with HCF’s Information Systems Group on website, intranet, and related technology implementation and support.
**Creative Strategy, Brand Stewardship and Quality Assurance**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead HCF’s visual brand strategy and identity across print, digital, web, environmental, video, and multimedia platforms.
* Create and maintain standards, templates, guidelines, and governance practices that support brand consistency, quality, accessibility, and inclusive design.
* Develop creative strategies and visual storytelling that support fundraising, programs, initiatives, stakeholder engagement, and organizational objectives.
* Collaborate with HCF departments and leadership to translate strategies and stakeholder needs into compelling creative solutions.
* Provide creative direction, mentorship, and quality assurance for the Multimedia Designer and assigned creative contributors.
* Monitor emerging design trends, technologies, platforms, and tools to improve creative practices and digital content across media.
**Hands\-On Design and Multimedia Production**
----------------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior hands\-on designer producing polished materials for print, digital, web, environmental, presentation, event, and multimedia use.
* Design high\-visibility reports, donor and campaign collateral, brochures, ads, signage, event materials, presentations, toolkits, templates, and branded resources.
* Develop original concepts and production\-ready designs that meet objectives, audience needs, brand standards, accessibility requirements, and technical specifications.
* Prepare, proof, package, and release files for print and digital distribution, coordinating with printers and vendors on specifications, estimates, proofs, quality, and delivery.
* Create and adapt digital assets for websites, email, social media, advertising, presentations, and owned or paid channels.
* Provide backup multimedia production support, including basic video, motion, audio, image, compression, captioning, and publishing\-ready assets.
* Operate cameras, lighting, microphones, and related equipment to support storytelling, events, interviews, and content needs.
* Maintain organized files, templates, multimedia assets, and archives for efficient updates, reuse, and team access.
**Supervision and Talent Development**
--------------------------------------

* Provide leadership and direction for all multimedia functions through direct supervision of the Multimedia Designer.
* Recruit, oversee, and advance creative talent, including staff, contractors, vendors, and other creative professionals as assigned.
* Build a collaborative, accountable, high\-performing creative culture that supports professional growth, design excellence, and innovation.
* Motivate strong performance through shared goals, clear expectations, timely communication, and constructive feedback.
**Other Responsibilities**
--------------------------

* Expand skills and knowledge of communications, design, technology, and the philanthropic sector by attending relevant meetings, workshops, seminars, and conferences.
* Serve as a knowledgeable and collaborative representative of HCF in the community.
* Partner collaboratively with other staff members to ensure effective outcomes.
* Deliver excellent service to internal and external clients and exceed HCF’s service standards whenever possible.
* Perform other tasks as assigned.
**Position Qualifications**
===========================


HCF believes in ensuring that our team members are capable of thriving in their positions. Accordingly, the Creative Director must possess the following knowledge, skills, abilities, experience, and education:

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Marketing, Fine Arts, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience required.
* Demonstrated experience developing creative strategies, leading multidisciplinary creative teams, and managing creative projects from concept through delivery required.
* 10\+ years of professional design experience, including 5\+ years in a senior or lead creative role.
* 4\+ years of experience managing staff and/or contractors.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and digital design tools.
* Strong portfolio demonstrating brand leadership, high\-impact multi\-platform design, and personal execution of complex, high\-visibility projects across print and digital channels.
* Advanced print design and production experience, including prepress, proofing, color management, vendor coordination, and preparation of press\-ready files.
* Working proficiency in multimedia production tools and techniques, including video editing, motion graphics, audio editing, image retouching, captioning, digital asset optimization, and backup production support.
* Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, or comparable video and motion\-design applications.
* Working knowledge of photography, videography, lighting, audio capture, and multimedia production equipment.
* Experience managing creative production workflows, budgets, and external partners.
* Deep understanding of inclusive design, accessibility, and audience\-centered storytelling.
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**
-----------------------------------

* Experience with email marketing platforms, content management systems, and SharePoint Online websites.
* Experience managing website redesigns, ongoing site enhancements, content governance, and maintenance.
* Experience communicating interactive ideas in\-browser with front\-end reference code, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience integrating digital and non\-digital communications practices and tools to support a seamless user experience across platforms.
* Solid foundation in typography, layout, graphic design, copywriting, creative strategy, and design thinking.
* Excellent visual, written, and oral communication skills and strong aesthetic judgment.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with government officials, business and nonprofit leaders, donors, community partners, vendors, and other constituents.
* Ability to exercise discretion with sensitive or confidential information related to clients, donors, relationships, and funds.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, timelines, budgets, expectations, progress updates, problem\-solving, and deadlines.
* Ability to receive direction effectively and work both collaboratively and autonomously.
**Alignment to Culture and Values**
-----------------------------------

* Thorough knowledge, sensitivity, and understanding of the history and complexities of Hawai‘i’s multicultural community, as well as current events and social issues.
* Demonstrated passion for the betterment of Hawai‘i and its people.
* Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative and flexible organization, with appreciation and respect for colleagues of diverse backgrounds and perspectives and enthusiasm to continually shift and evolve to meet the needs of the community, clients, and donors.
**Work Environment, Physical and Mental Demands**
=================================================

* Works under regular in\-office conditions with the ability to work remotely.
* General office hours are Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., with flexible hours as needed to handle priority items and/or manage events.
* Required to travel as needed.
* Ability to multitask, adapt to changing priorities, and meet deadlines, often within tight time frames.
* Ability to operate general office and multimedia production equipment, including a computer, copier, printers, cameras, lighting, microphones, and related accessories.
* Ability to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 25 pounds of general office or production materials and equipment.

title: U.S. Creative Director, Zoic Labs
description:
**About Zoic Labs**  

  

Zoic Labs is an Experience Engineering company, focused on the strategic design and development of immersive, interactive and user\-centric experiences.  

  

We blend principles of UX/UI design, psychology, advanced technology, and storytelling to create seamless, engaging, and functional digital and physical interactions. Our dynamic and multi\-disciplinary team has deep expertise in video game, XR, and web tool design and leverages a robust product development pipeline.  

  

We work for a diverse mix of government and commercial clients.

**The Role**  

We're looking for a Creative Director to help ideate, define, and present solutions with cutting\-edge look, feel, and function across our client experiences. You'll work where design, psychology, storytelling, and emerging technology meet, turning early ideas into interactive prototypes that show clients what's possible and what their users need.  

  

You'll lead the front end of our creative process: understanding client goals, generating original concepts, prototyping them quickly across game, XR, and web platforms, and presenting to build confidence and buy\-in. Working with designers, developers, and project leads, you'll carry the strongest ideas forward in alignment with clients and stakeholders, so bold creative visions become experiences that are intuitive, functional, and ready for real\-world use.  

  

Your work will span commercial and government clients, from engaging consumer\-facing experiences to mission\-focused training and operational tools. Each comes with its own users, constraints, and definition of success.  

  

This role suits someone who thrives in early\-stage ambiguity, moves easily from sketch to working build, and is equally comfortable working remote, onsite with clients, or on the road with our business development team. Some of the most important work happens in those first meetings, where reading the room and sketching out what's possible on the spot is what earns the engagement.

description:
**WHO WE ARE**


Come join the company reinventing data security, empowering businesses to realize the full potential of their data. As the leading data security platform purpose\-built for the cloud era, Cyera’s mission is to reinvent how businesses secure data, enable agile collaboration, and boldly pursue new business opportunities. Backed by the world’s leading investors and working with a large and growing list of Fortune 1000 companies, we are looking for world\-class talent to join us as we usher in the new era of data security.

 **THE OPPORTUNITY**


We’re hiring a Creative Director to bring Cyera’s brand to life across every campaign and every touchpoint where a customer, prospect, or employee meets us. Reporting to the Head of Corporate Marketing, you will be a key strategic leader of Cyera’s brand and a core creative voice on the marketing leadership team.


This is not an execution\-only role. We’re looking for a creative leader who pairs strong visual instincts with strong writing, and who treats every campaign as a chance to tell a story people remember. You’ll partner closely with Design Studio, Integrated Marketing, and other functions across marketing to make sure Cyera’s brand shows up with the same craft and clarity everywhere it appears, and you’ll lead a small creative team that you’ll be expected to grow, in capability and in ambition.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* **Brand storytelling across campaigns.** Turn Cyera’s positioning and messaging into campaigns that fuse strong visuals with strong copy. Define and build briefs that serve as a guide to make every campaign feel like one idea, carried consistently across every channel and format.
* **Creative direction for key touchpoints.** Set the creative bar for the moments that matter most: launches, events, the website, sales collateral, social, and executive communications. Make sure the brand feels like one brand, wherever someone meets it.
* **Partnership with Design Studio.** Work hand in hand with Design Studio to turn creative concepts into finished work. Bring clear direction, sharp feedback, and a point of view that raises the level of what gets made.
* **Partnership with Integrated Marketing.** Sit alongside Integrated Marketing from the start of campaign planning, so creative is built into strategy rather than added at the end. Help turn campaign briefs into ideas that earn attention.
* **Creative team leadership.** Lead, coach, and grow a small creative team across Copy and Video. Model the craft, help your team members develop into stronger creative thinkers, and build the bench for Cyera’s next stage of growth.
* **Brand stewardship.** Act as a guardian of Cyera’s voice and identity across the company. Give partners across marketing, sales, and product the creative guardrails they need to move fast without losing consistency.

  

Requirements:  

  

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* 10\-12 years of creative experience, including time as an art director, creative director, or similar role, ideally at a B2B technology company or a category\-defining brand.

* Strong stakeholder management. You build trust with partners across marketing, sales, and product, and you know how to hold a creative point of view while navigating competing priorities.
* People leadership. You’ve hired, coached, and grown creative talent, and people want to do their best work for you.
