Mission Planning Engineer - MOPS
description:
AST SpaceMobile is building the first and only global cellular broadband network in space to operate directly with standard, unmodified mobile devices based on our extensive IP and patent portfolio and designed for both commercial and government applications. Our engineers and space scientists are on a mission to eliminate the connectivity gaps faced by today's five billion mobile subscribers and finally bring broadband to the billions who remain unconnected.

**Position Overview**



We are seeking a Mission Planning Engineer to develop, automate, and maintain the mission operations processes, tools, and procedures required for successful operations planning for the AST SpaceMobile satellite constellation. This role blends mission operations engineering with software\-driven automation, with a strong emphasis on scripting satellite procedures, developing operational tooling, and enabling scalable, reliable constellation operations. This position plays a critical role in shaping how the Satellite Operations Center (SOC) functions day\-to\-day and evolves over the lifetime of the constellation, providing operational insight into system design while actively building the automation and procedures used on orbit.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Develop daily activity plan for all spacecraft in the fleet.
* Populate and validate all procedures necessary to execute the activity plan.
* Manage and prioritize real\-time activity requests.
* Load balance activities across the fleet and the crews.
* Coordinate with payload and subsystem engineers to ensure parallel activity compatibility.
* Coordinate contact scheduling with commercial TTC providers.
* Develop, test, and validate satellite operations procedures, sequences of events, and command scripts used for on\-orbit operations.
* Script and automate satellite command and control procedures using languages such as Python (and similar scripting languages).
* Develop telemetry validation logic and expected response checks to support both automated and manual operations.
* Modify and improve procedures based on on\-orbit performance and lessons learned.
* Design, develop, and maintain custom mission operations tools and automation scripts.
* Develop tooling and lightweight applications to support on\-orbit operations, monitoring, and analysis.
* Build or extend user interfaces, dashboards, or visualization tools that improve operator situational awareness.
* Interface with internal and external APIs to integrate mission operations workflows.
* Support system\-level integration tests and end\-to\-end testing between the SOC and factory satellite.
* Participate in mission readiness activities including operations tests, simulations, rehearsals, and dry runs.
* Support mission operations during LEOP and other critical on\-orbit activities, including possible periodic rotating shifts.
* Work closely with systems engineers, flight software, ground software, and external vendors to develop operational products.
* Support requirements development, architecture reviews, design reviews, readiness reviews, and program milestones.
* Provide mentoring and technical guidance to mission operations team members.


**Qualifications**


**Education:**



Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Technology, or Math (STEM) field.


**Experience:**


* 2\-5\+ years of relevant experience in mission operations, software development, or automation roles.
* Experience scripting operational procedures or automation workflows using Python or similar languages.
* Familiarity with satellite command and control operations and mission operations workflows.
* Comfortable working in a Windows development and operations environment.
* Experience working with applications deployed in AWS or other cloud environments.
* Familiarity with Git or other version control systems.
* Familiarity with the Atlassian tool suite (Jira, Confluence).


**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with multi\-satellite LEO constellations.
* Experience developing or operating automated mission operations systems.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, networking protocols, and API\-based integrations.
* Experience creating telemetry displays, monitoring dashboards, or operator UIs.
* Basic experience with databases or data persistence for operational tooling.
* Systems engineering experience or coursework (requirements, architecture, integration \& test).
* Experience supporting mission rehearsals, simulations, or critical on\-orbit operations.


**Soft Skills:**


* Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to work independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment with evolving system requirements.
* Self\-starter who takes ownership and initiative.
* Comfortable working to tight deadlines in high\-stress operational environments.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with a remote, distributed, and cross\-disciplinary team.
* Strong operational mindset with a bias toward automation and reliability.


**Technology Stack:**


* Python and similar scripting languages for satellite command and control automation.
* Windows\-based development and operations environments.
* AWS or other cloud environments for deployed applications.
* Git or other version control systems.
* Atlassian tool suite (Jira, Confluence).
* Telemetry validation, dashboard, and visualization tooling for operator situational awareness.


**Physical Requirements**


* Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.
* Ability to use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to work in a standard office environment.
* Ability to support periodic rotating shifts during LEOP and other critical on\-orbit operations.

title: Data-AI Architect
description:
**Why Join dLocal?**  

dLocal is the financial infrastructure powering global commerce in the world's fastest\-growing markets. The biggest companies in the world trust us to unlock growth in 60\+ countries across emerging markets—moving money where others see complexity. We don't just process payments; we are architects of payment ecosystems and partners in our customers' expansion. You'll work alongside 1,300\+ teammates from 40\+ nationalities and tackle global challenges from day one.

  

### **What’s the opportunity?**



We are looking for a Data Architect to provide the technical direction for dLocal’s data and analytics architecture. This role will shape a scalable, governed, and highly consumable data ecosystem across Data \& AI and engineering—connecting domain\-owned data products, real\-time platforms, analytical workloads, machine\-learning use cases, and business\-facing data consumption.



You will act as a senior technical reference for architecture decisions, translating business and product needs into pragmatic designs that balance scalability, reliability, latency, security, interoperability, developer experience, and total cost of ownership.



### **What will I be doing?**


* Define and evolve enterprise data architectures, evaluate trade\-offs, and recommend fit\-for\-purpose technology patterns across batch, streaming, lakehouse, warehouse, and operational use cases.
* Review and advise other architects on the data aspects of their RFCs, helping ensure consistency with enterprise data principles, governance standards, and architectural direction.
* Lead the adoption of data\-mesh principles, including domain\-oriented ownership, data as a product, federated computational governance, self\-serve platform capabilities, discoverability, quality, and measurable data\-product SLAs.
* Establish reference architectures and engineering standards for data products, pipelines, ingestion, storage, processing, orchestration, observability, lineage, security, and access management.
* Provide oversight on operational SLAs, including latency, cost, quality, freshness, reliability, and production performance.
* Design and govern streaming architectures using technologies such as Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and Databricks, supporting use cases from scheduled batch through sub\-second real\-time processing.
* Define reliable event\-processing patterns, including schema and data contracts, schema registries, event\-time processing, late\-event handling, idempotency, deduplication, replay and reprocessing, dead\-letter flows, and freshness SLAs.
* Shape semantic layers and enterprise ontologies that create consistent business meaning across domains, including canonical entities, metrics, dimensions, relationships, business definitions, metadata, lineage, and versioning.
* Establish patterns that allow semantic models to serve analytics, operational applications, machine learning, and AI use cases without creating duplicated or contradictory definitions.
* Guide the evolution of cloud data platforms and lakehouse capabilities, including Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta/Iceberg tables, object storage, data warehouses, and BI consumption layers across AWS and GCP environments.
* Provide architectural direction for MLOps and feature\-platform capabilities, including batch and online features, model\-serving integrations, low\-latency data paths, model/data lineage, monitoring, and governance.
* Lead or contribute to architecture RFCs, technical decisions, design reviews, migration plans, and implementation roadmaps; make complex trade\-offs clear to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with domain teams to clarify ownership, data\-product responsibilities, operational handover, quality accountability, access approval, and cross\-domain consumption models.
* Define practical controls for data quality, observability, privacy, security, resilience, cost management, and production readiness.
* Take ownership of critical architectural issues, facilitate resolution across teams, and ensure decisions are followed through to implementation and operation.
* Act as a trusted advisor and technical mentor to data engineers, platform teams, data scientists, MLOps engineers, BI teams, and engineering leaders.
* Communicate a cohesive architectural vision while remaining pragmatic, adaptable, and close enough to implementation to validate that designs work in production.
### **What skills do I need?**


* 8–10\+ years of experience designing and operating scalable data architectures, preferably in complex enterprise or high\-growth environments.
* Strong experience designing and implementing data\-mesh architectures and operating models, including domain ownership, data products, federated governance, self\-serve platforms, contracts, quality, and discoverability.
* Deep experience with streaming and event\-driven architectures, including Kafka or Kinesis and one or more processing engines such as Flink or Spark Structured Streaming.
* Demonstrated ability to design for real\-time and near\-real\-time workloads, including latency measurement, event\-time semantics, late data, state, deduplication, idempotency, replay, and failure recovery.
* Strong knowledge of semantic layers, business ontologies, canonical data models, knowledge graphs or metadata models, metric definitions, and semantic governance.
* Expertise in data modeling, data lake and lakehouse patterns, warehouse design, data pipelines, data products, metadata, lineage, and data management technologies.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and services, particularly AWS and/or GCP; experience with Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Iceberg, or comparable technologies is valuable.
* Proficiency with relevant data and platform technologies such as Spark, Airflow, dbt, Kafka, Python, SQL, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, and observability tooling.
* Experience architecting or supporting MLOps, feature stores, online/offline data serving, or other low\-latency machine\-learning data systems.
* Ability to establish practical frameworks for data access, stewardship, governance, privacy, security, quality, and operational accountability.
* Strong understanding of reliability, scalability, performance, resilience, cost, and vendor lock\-in trade\-offs.
* Excellent stakeholder\-management, communication, facilitation, and influencing skills, including the ability to balance delivery expectations and technical excellence.
* Comfortable managing risk, ambiguity, and conflict; able to make decisions and explain the reasoning behind them.
* Self\-sufficient and proactive, with the judgment to know when to seek input and when to move forward.
**What do we offer?**  

Besides the tailored benefits we have for each country, dLocal will help you thrive and go that extra mile by offering you:  

* **Flexibility in how you work:** We focus on impact and productivity over fixed hours. This means our teams have flexible schedules and, depending on your role and location, you will combine self‑managed focus time with moments of in‑person connection in our collaboration hubs.
* **Fintech industry:** work in a dynamic and ever\-evolving environment, with plenty to build and boost your creativity.


\- **Referral bonus program:** our internal talents are the best recruiters \- refer someone ideal for a role and get rewarded.  

* **Work From Anywhere:** Team members can work while traveling for up to 3 months every year.
  



**What happens after you apply?**
Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin and Youtube for more about dLocal!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

IT Manager
description:
**About the role**


We’re opening a delivery centre in Valencia. We are looking for an IT Manager to take operational ownership of the projects delivered there and to work as the direct deputy of the person running the site.


This is a launch role. The centre is being set up now, the team is being hired now, and the way it works has not been decided yet. Our site lead stays close to the clients and to business development. You take the operational side: framing the projects, running delivery, coordinating the teams, and helping build the structure as it grows. You will be introduced to clients as his counterpart, so the role is visible from day one. The scope is deliberately broad. It sits across project management, product ownership and business analysis, and the balance shifts from one project to the next. Generative AI is a real part of how they works.


The role does not require deep technical AI expertise, no agent development, no RAG, no MCP. It requires genuine curiosity and handson practice with AI tools, enough to hold a conversation with the engineering teams, spot the use cases worth pursuing, and bring them into the product roadmap.


Contract type Permanent or freelance to start, depending on what suits you.


If starting freelance, permanent contract required after a few months.


**Your responsibilities**


1\. **Project framing** Gather and formalize business requirements with stakeholders. Define scope, deliverables, milestones and success criteria. Write the requirement documents, functional specifications and technical specifications.


2\. **Product roadmap** Build and prioritize the product roadmap against business value and technical constraints. Arbitrate between business needs, technical reality and deadlines. Own the timeline and keep stakeholders informed.


3\. **Technical delivery** Write user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria. Prioritise and manage the backlog. Validate deliverables with both the technical and the business side. Coordinate across teams: development, design, data and external providers.


4\. **Budget Estimate** and track project effort and budget. Report regularly to management and sponsors. Optimize the balance between internal resources and external providers.


5\. **Risk and trade\-offs** Identify and manage project risks. Arbitrate between technical constraints and business objectives. Escalate blockers to the right level at the right time.


6\. **Governance** Run project committees and agile ceremonies, from sprint reviews through to planning sessions. Prepare progress reporting materials. Report to sponsors and management.


7\. **Stakeholder management** Act as the interface between the creative, technical, business and client sides. Adapt your communication to each audience and manage expectations. Hold the position of facilitator and arbitrator between parties.


8\. **Team coordination** Lead or coordinate technical teams, internal and external. Distribute workload, follow performance, keep the team engaged.


9\. **Quality and acceptance** Define acceptance criteria. Validate that deliverables meet them before they go to production.


10\. **Release and post\-launch** Coordinate deployments and production releases. Track performance indicators after launch.


11\. **Methodology** Work in Agile and Scrum, or in a V\-cycle where the context calls for it. Adapt the methodological framework to the maturity of the organisation you are working with.


12\. **Bringing AI into the work** Keep an active watch on generative AI tools and how they are actually being used. Identify where AI genuinely saves time in the product and project process, whether that is drafting specifications, generating summaries or automating repetitive work. Hold a credible conversation with the engineering teams on AI topics without needing to implement them yourself

**Your profile**


Education Bachelor's or Master's level in engineering, project management, computer science or equivalent.


Experience 5 to 15 years in IT project management, product ownership or business analysis, ideally a mix of the three.


**Languages**


* French is required. Several of our clients work in French and you’re working closely with the president and director.
* English is required. The engineering team works in English.
* Spanish is not required. Location
* Based in Valencia, or ready to relocate there. This role is not open to full remote. Proximity matters more here than in any other role in the team, because the job is built around working side by side with the site lead.
* Trips to Paris every month needed to visit the rest of the team there.

title: Director of Engineering
description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people \- helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.


What started in Poland is now an international, cloud\-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.


For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.


Working in a rapidly growing, ever\-changing scale\-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.


The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:

* Own end\-to\-end delivery across 4–5 cross\-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff\+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
* Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
* Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
* Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
* Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.

  

**Requirements**  

  

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…* To think like a product owner, not a ticket\-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
* Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
* Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day\-to\-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
* To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high\-growth scale\-up or high\-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
* At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business\-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.


It will also help you to have…* Experience with two\-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
* Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
* B2B SaaS experience at scale.

  

**Benefits**  

* We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote\-first.
* Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote \- either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
* Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.

 **How AI helps us find great people**


Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role \- but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application \- it won't affect your chances in any way.

**Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:**


We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at belonging@booksy.com, so we can best support you.

As a (Senior) UX/UI Designer – Digital Products, you design intuitive, effective and visually clear experiences across our digital ecosystem (web, app and internal applications). You apply a Lean UX mindset – working iteratively, testing assumptions early and focusing on measurable outcomes rather than heavy documentation.


You collaborate closely with Product, Engineering and Data/AI to define problems, test hypotheses and ship solutions grounded in data, user research and continuous feedback – for both human users and AI/synthetic users (e.g. automated agents or AI\-powered systems).


Depending on your experience, you will either grow into or already take on a senior role with greater ownership, stakeholder alignment and mentoring responsibilities.

	+ Work in small, iterative steps

	+ Validate assumptions quickly with users and data
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Data/AI and Business to:
	+ Understand user needs, pain points and business goals
	+ Define problem statements, hypotheses and success metrics

Together, we're building coherent, accessible experiences that honor our 135\-year foundation while pushing us boldly into the future. We're a globally distributed team spearheading a digital transformation at Dow Jones, newly staffed by industry leaders from Google, LinkedIn, The New York Times, and more. Through our joint expertise in design craft and research rigor, we ensure that millions of users can depend on our platforms for truth in a world full of noise.


**About the Role:**


We're seeking a Principal Product Designer to own the design strategy for our WSJ enterprise products—professional experiences that bring The Wall Street Journal and the wider Dow Jones portfolio to the businesses and institutions that rely on our journalism to make informed decisions. In this a senior individual\-contributor role, you will set the direction for one of our growth areas and become a go\-to design expert on how Dow Jones serves enterprise and professional customers.


Enterprise customers don’t always consume content the way consumers do. Designing for them means thinking beyond the article—how a professional finds what's relevant to their work, how an organization manages access for its employees, and how our trusted journalism earns a place in the working day of decision\-makers. You'll hold enterprise design to the high bar set by our consumer products and be tightly integrated with the platforms guaranteeing these decision\-makers are empowered with WSJ \+ Dow Jones content.


This is a role with influence and scope. You'll shape strategy with senior design, product, and business leadership, resolve the tension between enterprise requirements and consumer\-grade craft, contribute to the enterprise patterns that live in our Index Design System, and mentor senior designers across both our professional and consumer brands. You'll be the design authority for your domain—navigating ambiguity and setting the standard others build upon.


You will report to the SVP of Product Design within the Design \& Research organization.


**You Will:**


* Own the design strategy for our enterprise experiences. Set a coherent, multi\-year direction for how professional customers discover, read, and act on our journalism, and tie it to measurable outcomes such as seat growth, engagement, renewal, and expansion
* Own the admin experience that powers the reader experience. Design how organizations manage seats, assign content, and understand engagement across their teams
* Hold enterprise work to the Journal's standard of craft. Bring the typography, information design, and attention to detail that characterize our consumer products into a business environment, and help set the bar for what enterprise design quality means at Dow Jones
* Shape strategy with senior leadership. Present your direction to senior design, product, and business leaders, and to other executives where needed, building the partnerships that move great design forward across a field of competing priorities
* Establish further patterns in our Index Design System—the components, density, navigation, and permission\-aware behavior that professional products depend on—knowing when conformity with our consumer brands serves the user and when a professional audience warrants a different approach
* Solve the hard, ambiguous problems in your domain. Professional workflows, AI\-assisted features users must trust, and personalization that must earn its place are problems devoid of clear precedent. You'll create clarity where none exists and develop the approaches others adopt
* Connect design to outcomes. Partner with Research and analytics to tie your decisions to engagement, retention, and revenue, and help teams understand which measures actually matter for a professional product
* Mentor and grow senior designers across our professional and consumer brands, shape a strong design culture, and strengthen the talent pipeline through the standards you set and the craft you share

**You Have:**


* 10\+ years of product design experience, including significant time owning complex, systems\-level or platform work, with a track record of setting design direction that spans multiple products or audiences
* Depth in both enterprise and consumer design. You've built products for professional users with real workflows and real constraints, and you hold that work to the standard of the best consumer experiences. This combination is the core requirement of the role.
* Experience designing professional platforms—workspaces, dashboards, personalized feeds, admin and permissions tooling
* A portfolio that demonstrates strategic impact across multiple products or audiences: platform or design\-system contributions, cross\-team pattern\-setting, and strong end\-to\-end craft on sophisticated products
* A proven ability to influence senior stakeholders, translating design strategy into business terms and building alignment across teams whose priorities compete
* Strong systems thinking and deep experience with design systems, including establishing patterns that other teams adopt and evolve
* Judgment about personalization and AI\-assisted experiences—when they genuinely help a professional user, when they diminish trust, and how to design for these scenarios
* Excellence in Figma, with the ability to set standards for design communication, specifications, and documentation across teams
* A deep command of design fundamentals and accessibility compliance standards (WCAG), with fluency in dense, information\-rich interfaces
* A track record of mentoring designers and helping raise the craft and quality of the teams around you
* Comfort operating amid ambiguity—setting direction in your domain during shifting priorities and emerging technology, and acting as the go\-to expert others turn to

title: RevOps Product Owner – AI & Automation
description:
**Descripción de la empresa**


Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online.


Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países.


Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.


Buscamos un/a **RevOps Product Owner – AI \& Automation** para ser dueño/a de cuatro productos clave de RevOps en España como un portafolio: diagnosticar qué está roto o falta acercándote a cómo se hace el trabajo realmente, escribir las specs que justifican el caso de negocio, negociar prioridad con los equipos globales que controlan estos sistemas, y construir directamente lo que esté al alcance local — incluyendo testeo práctico y prototipado de herramientas e integraciones, aunque la implementación final sea de otro equipo.

### **Los productos de los que serás dueño/a**

* **CRM Process \& Automation** — la salud de nuestros flujos comerciales core en Salesforce/HubSpot: cumplimiento de SLA, higiene de pipeline y la automatización declarativa que mantiene los registros correctos a medida que deals y leads avanzan por el funnel — por ejemplo, que una propiedad se actualice automáticamente cuando un deal pasa a la siguiente etapa — además de la infraestructura de dashboards/reporting que los equipos usan cada día.
* **Lead Creation \& Assignment** — la lógica de enrutamiento y asignación que lleva cada lead al rep correcto en el momento correcto (construida sobre DP Lead), evolucionando hacia un modelo ponderado por capacidad y rendimiento en lugar de round\-robin plano.
* **Omni\-Channel** — la capa de WhatsApp (Kraken), llamadas, email/secuencias y agendamiento/calendario en todo el journey de sales \+ CS: qué canal, qué mensaje, en qué secuencia y cuándo — incluyendo el agendamiento y reagendamiento de demos, onboarding y reuniones de farming.
* **CRM UI/UX** — la experiencia diaria real que tienen reps y team leads dentro del CRM: comportamiento del action center, vistas, filtros y los gaps que causan tareas perdidas o workarounds mal usados.

### **Qué harás**

* **Ser dueño/a del backlog de cada producto** — diagnosticar qué está roto, falta o funciona mal en las cuatro áreas, acercándote a las personas que hacen el trabajo: shadowing, entrevistas, peticiones directas y observación propia — no suposiciones.
* **Triar lo que es tuyo** — las peticiones rutinarias de business\-as\-usual van a COE como siempre; los bottlenecks reales e issues sistémicos llegan a tu backlog para un zoom\-in adecuado.
* **Escribir las specs que justifican el caso** — convertir un problema diagnosticado en una solicitud clara y priorizada: qué está mal, qué nos cuesta, cómo sería la solución, por qué vale la pena el tiempo de ingeniería global.
* **Negociar prioridad con los equipos globales dueños de estos sistemas** — la mayoría de los cambios core en Salesforce, Kraken y otras plataformas subyacentes solo pueden hacerlos equipos fuera de RevOps España; tú eres quien construye el caso de negocio y asegura un lugar en su roadmap.
* **Testear y prototipar, de forma práctica** — validar herramientas de terceros, prototipar integraciones y entender cómo se conectan las piezas antes de pasar una spec al equipo que la construirá. Construir directamente la automatización y configuración que esté al alcance local.
* **Medir lo que lanzas o desbloqueas** — horas ahorradas, impacto en conversión/engagement y adopción, por producto. Reportar en términos de los OKRs de RevOps.
* **Hacerlo repetible** — documentar lo que funciona en playbooks o templates reutilizables.

### **Qué buscamos**

* Conocimiento profundo de las herramientas y procesos de GTM de Doctoralia España — ya lo tienes en la mayoría de estas cuatro áreas.
* Mentalidad de builder para lo que sí es construible localmente, e instinto de tester para validar herramientas e integraciones antes de que se entreguen a otro equipo. Experiencia práctica con automatización de Salesforce/HubSpot (flows, reglas de validación, triggers) es un plus importante.
* Comunicación escrita sólida — capaz de convertir un problema reportado de forma informal en una spec clara y convincente que un equipo global, con sus propias prioridades, realmente atienda.
* Cómodo/a negociando capacidad de ingeniería escasa con equipos que no te reportan, y dando seguimiento hasta que se lance.
* Fluidez en español e inglés.

### **Métricas de éxito**


La medida principal de éxito es el **throughput por operador de GTM** — cada cambio lanzado debe permitir que la gente haga más de lo que ya se espera de ella, no solo "ahorrar tiempo" de forma abstracta. Se mide como una tendencia direccional para el rol afectado tras un cambio lanzado, no como una atribución estrictamente aislada — hay demasiadas otras iniciativas en paralelo (la migración a Salesforce, la ingeniería de outbound, etc.) como para separar causas de forma limpia. Esto se acumula en **revenue (o output) por FTE de GTM**, nuestra métrica de eficiencia principal.

**Throughput por rol (principal):**

* SDRs / reps de outbound — reuniones agendadas por rep por semana/mes.
* Account Executives — oportunidades avanzadas o deals cerrados por AE.
* Especialistas de onboarding — onboardings completados por especialista en un período dado.
* Reps de CS / soporte — casos o solicitudes resueltas por rep.
* Reps de farming / cuentas — acciones de renovación o upsell completadas por rep.

**Prerrequisito (hito inicial, no asumido):** la instrumentación fiable de throughput por rol todavía no existe del todo — el reporting ha sido poco fiable en varias de estas áreas hasta hace poco. Establecer un tracking de baseline limpio para al menos tres de los cinco roles anteriores (en parte a través del trabajo de dashboards de CRM Process \& Automation) es en sí mismo un entregable del primer trimestre, no algo asumido de antemano.

### **Qué ofrecemos**

* Ownership total de cuatro productos reales y ya diagnosticados — no ejecución de tareas, sino responsabilidad genuina de producto de principio a fin.
* Espacio para profundizar de forma práctica donde importa — testear, prototipar y conectar herramientas, no solo escribir specs.
* Un camino hacia un conocimiento más profundo de cómo está construido y configurado Salesforce internamente, más allá de lo que tendrías quedándote solo en el lado local/HubSpot.
* Colaboración directa con el Head of Revenue Operations y, una vez cubierta, con el/la futuro/a RevOps Product Manager – AI Solutions.
* Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

**Información adicional**


Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.


Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.


Seguro médico privado.


Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.


Clases de idiomas gratuitas.


Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.


Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

**Nuestro proceso de selección**

Primer match – Una charla con Fito (TAP).  

Conversación estratégica – Entrevista con Elías .


Presentación de un Business Case \- con Elías nuestro Head of RevOps.

title: Senior UX Designer (Space Engineers Franchise)
description:
At Keen Software House, we develop large\-scale sandbox simulation games like Space Engineers 1 and Space Engineers 2, built around engineering, construction, destruction, physics, emergent gameplay, and player creativity, together with the proprietary technology that powers them.


**We are looking for a Senior UX Designer with professional experience in the video game industry to join our international team working across Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2\.**



Space Engineers is a complex sandbox game built around engineering, construction, exploration, survival, and player creativity. That complexity is part of what makes the game unique \- but it also creates significant UX challenges.



We are looking for someone who can take real ownership of how players interact with our systems, identify usability problems, and turn complex mechanics and information into clear and intuitive player experiences.



Because we are a relatively small team, we are looking for a hands\-on and versatile UX Designer who can contribute beyond UX theory, wireframes, and documentation. Strong UX expertise is the foundation of the role, but ideally you also bring visual/UI design skills or, alternatively, experience with technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation. Visual/UI design is particularly valuable for us given the current composition of the team.



You will work closely with Game Design, Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, helping shape both existing and new features from early concepts through to implementation.



We expect you to act as a proactive UX partner \- identify friction, challenge existing solutions when needed, test assumptions, and help us establish stronger UX principles across both games.


**While our studio is based in Prague, we offer the flexibility to work remotely within Europe (CET \+/\- 2 hours).**



If you enjoy challenging work, autonomy, impact, and responsibility, come and join us

  


**Required profile**
--------------------


* **5\+ years of professional experience as a UX Designer, Game UX Designer, or similar role, with significant experience working in the video game industry on PC and/or console games**
* Proven experience designing UX for shipped video games, ideally across multiple features or systems
* Strong portfolio or case studies demonstrating your UX process, including problem definition, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, iteration, and final solutions
* Hands\-on approach to UX design, **with experience in at least one adjacent discipline that allows you to contribute beyond UX documentation – ideally UI/visual design, or alternatively technical UI prototyping, integration, or implementation**
* Strong understanding of interaction design, information architecture, user flows, usability principles, navigation systems, and information hierarchy
* Experience working on sandbox, simulation, strategy, management, or other systems\-heavy games
* Strong experience designing UX for complex and interconnected game systems, such as inventories, building systems, crafting, progression, control schemes, or similar mechanics
* Ability to make complex mechanics and information understandable and intuitive without removing their depth
* Strong wireframing and prototyping skills using Figma or equivalent tools
* Experience creating and evolving UX/UI design systems, interaction patterns, and reusable component libraries
* Experience designing UX for both mouse \& keyboard and controller\-based interaction
* Experience validating UX solutions through usability testing, playtesting, player research, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, or similar methods
* Knowledge of accessibility principles in game UX
* Strong design judgment – able to identify usability problems and their root causes, propose practical solutions, and explain design decisions using player needs, evidence, and clear reasoning
* Ability to work effectively with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA, understand technical and production constraints, and incorporate them into UX solutions
* Proactive and self\-driven, with the ability to work independently, iterate quickly, receive feedback, and adapt solutions when needed
* Fluent English, spoken and written
* Shares and upholds our High Standards


DUE TO THE HIGH VOLUME OF APPLICATIONS, PLEASE NOTE THAT ONLY CANDIDATES WHO MEET THE KEY REQUIREMENTS OF THE ROLE AND ARE SELECTED FOR THE NEXT STAGE WILL BE CONTACTED.


**Nice to have**
----------------


* Strong visual/UI design skills, including typography, layout, iconography, visual hierarchy, and the ability to take UX concepts through to polished, production\-ready interface designs
* Experience creating or adapting UI assets and working within an established visual language or art direction
* Experience implementing or integrating UI directly in a game engine or proprietary engine
* Experience combining UX design with UI/visual design and/or technical implementation within the same role
* Experience working on live games and improving established systems without disrupting existing player workflows or expectations
* Experience working on sci\-fi, simulation, engineering, or other technically oriented games

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------


* Report to the Production Director and be part of a Game design team
* Take ownership of UX across **Space Engineers and Space Engineers 2**, covering both existing systems and new features
* Identify player friction and usability problems, understand their root causes, and propose practical improvements
* Work with Game Design, UI Art, Engineering, Production, and QA from the early stages of feature development to shape solutions that balance player needs, game design intent, visual clarity, technical feasibility, and production constraints
* Translate complex mechanics, systems, and requirements into clear and intuitive player experiences


**Define and improve:**


* + player flows and navigation
	+ information architecture and interaction patterns
	+ menus, HUD, and in\-game interactions
	+ system feedback
	+ onboarding and discoverability
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and UX specifications, exploring and validating solutions early before significant development time is invested
* Take solutions beyond UX documentation where appropriate to your skill set – whether through polished UI/visual design, high\-fidelity prototyping, or contributing to UI integration and implementation
* Use playtesting, player feedback, analytics, telemetry, and other available evidence to validate solutions and guide iteration
* Follow UX solutions through development, review implementation, and help ensure the intended player experience is preserved in the final product
* Establish and evolve consistent UX principles, interaction patterns, and design systems across both games
* Clearly communicate UX problems, design decisions, and trade\-offs to stakeholders using evidence, player needs, and clear reasoning
* Balance usability with game depth, technical limitations, development cost, existing player expectations, and long\-term maintainability
* Help improve UX practices across the wider development team and ensure UX is considered throughout development rather than treated as a final review step

**What we value**
-----------------


* Hold yourself to A\-player standards
* **Player\-first thinking without oversimplification** – make complex systems understandable while preserving the depth that makes Space Engineers unique
* **Hands\-on, versatile design** – UX should not stop at diagrams or recommendations; be comfortable turning ideas into tangible solutions and contributing beyond a narrowly defined UX role when needed
* **Problem solving over screen production** – understand the underlying player problem before designing the interface
* **Systems thinking** – understand how individual interactions connect to the broader player experience
* **Strong judgment and prioritisation** – recognise where UX problems have the greatest impact, understand trade\-offs, and focus effort where it matters most
* **Clarity over cleverness** – favour solutions that players can understand naturally, without unnecessary complexity
* **Iteration over attachment** – explore quickly, test assumptions, take feedback well, and change direction when a better solution emerges
* **Ownership and proactivity** – do not wait for perfectly defined UX problems; identify what needs to be solved and help drive it forward
* **Evidence over opinion** – use player behaviour, usability principles, testing, and clear reasoning rather than personal preference
* **Clear and direct communication** – explain UX problems, decisions, and trade\-offs clearly and challenge ideas constructively

**What you'll find at Keen Software House:**
--------------------------------------------


**Impact**


* Leave your mark on one of the most technically ambitious sandbox engineering games ever made.
* Join an international team tackling hard problems


**How we work:**


* Hybrid by default: work from home when you want
* Low bureaucracy, fast decisions

* 25 days of annual leave.
* Flexible sick leave.


**Workspace**


* Modern offices at Oranžerie, Prague \- quiet focus zones, beautiful garden, great daylight, quality equipment, bike storage, gym and shower, fully stocked kitchen, lunches prepared by our private chefs


**Community**


* Regular team breakfasts, workshops, and relaxed meetups (BBQ, game nights, parties, teambuildings)

* Operation of the Approval Gate for digitalization requests and projects — preparing decision recommendations for the Head of Hub.
* Continuous tracking of project progress across all Hub streams (Data, Digitalization \& AI) regarding budget, scope, timeline, and quality.
* Budget controlling for all transformation projects — planned vs. actual comparison, burn rate, forecast, Capex/Opex transparency.
* Prioritization and management of the cross\-stream backlog in collaboration with the Data Team (P2\) and Digitalization \& AI Team (P3\).
* Planning and communication of tool and feature releases in coordination with the Digitalization \& AI Team (P3\) and the Implementation Team (P4\).
* Analysis of digital product usage to define optimal user experience and derive improvement recommendations.
* Post\-go\-live benefit tracking — measuring adoption rates, realized savings, and qualitative impact against business case promises.
* Monitoring enablement progress of business units and tracking rollout milestone delivery by Digital Champions.
* Building and operating multi\-level dashboards (Power BI): strategic (SteerCo/Hub Lead), tactical (program level), and operational (project level).
* Close alignment and collaboration with all Hub teams and interfaces: P1 is the only function with Responsible (R) or Accountable (A) assignments across all four governance pillars. The Head of P1 coordinates closely with the Data Team for project data and KPI inputs, with the Digitalization \& AI Team for product performance and backlog, with the Implementation Team for release readiness and change status, and with Digital Champions for adoption data and domain milestones. P1 provides the consolidated performance view; the Head of Hub uses this as the basis for SteerCo reporting and strategic decisions.

 **Profile Requirements**

  

Professional Requirements

  

* University degree in business administration, business informatics, industrial engineering, or comparable qualification.
* 5\+ years of experience in project management, portfolio management, or performance management within a complex organization.
* Proven expertise in business case development and evaluation (ROI, NPV, TCO).
* Strong track record in designing and operating KPI frameworks and performance reporting systems.
* Hands\-on skills in dashboarding and reporting tools (Power BI, Excel, or comparable).
* Experience in budget controlling — creating cost transparency and managing variances.
* Knowledge of Agile (preferably SAFe) and traditional project management methodologies.
* Good understanding of digital products, data products, and IT delivery processes.
* Excellent German and English language skills.

  

Personal Requirements

  

* Entrepreneurial thinking — ability to build an entire function from scratch with a startup mentality.
* Leadership without a team (initially) — ability to deliver as a one\-person function while preparing for growth.
* Analytical and data\-driven — numbers, dashboards, and KPIs are the daily tools.
* Structured and systematic — bringing order to complexity across multiple parallel streams.
* Strong communication skills — ability to make complex performance data accessible for all audiences, from project teams to SteerCo.
* Diplomatically assertive — holding teams accountable and challenging constructively, including upward.
* Hands\-on mentality — willingness to build templates, dashboards, and processes personally before delegating.
* Resilience and patience — building a new function requires navigating ambiguity and incomplete data.

title: Head of GTM Systems & AI
description:
### **Introduction to the Team \& Role**



What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?

GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go\-to\-market faster, smarter and more effective.

We already have a high\-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.

You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.

This is a high\-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go\-to\-market strategy.

### **Key Responsibility Areas**


* Own the internal AI operating model for GTM — the library of skills, agent evals, cost, adoption and ROI — in partnership with Data and Enablement.
* Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
* Own the long\-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
* Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
* Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
* Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep\-or\-kill review, and renewals.
* Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
* Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.
### **What You'll Do**

**Within 1 month, you will:**
* Know the team, the stack, and the cross\-functional leaders and teams you’ll partner with
* Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
* Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.


  

**Within 3 months, you will:**
* Have taken one major cross\-functional change from plan to done
* Own the full vendor\-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
* Have co\-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.


  

**Within 6 months, you will:**
* Have co\-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.
* Have shipped at least one AI agent that watches business data and reaches people on its own, with a named business owner and outcome measures agreed before launch.
* Have a 12\-18 month roadmap, setting the high\-level vision across our systems infrastructure, ways of working, and AI portfolio


  

**Within 12 months, you will:**
* Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.
* Have a development path agreed with each member of the team.
* Have the team recognized as the company's reference for AI\-native operations
### **The Skill Set**


* 5\+ years across GTM systems, agentic/AI workflow products, revenue technology, enterprise SaaS — or an adjacent path like technical product management or consulting where you designed and shipped real systems with a strong AI mandate.
* Turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable tooling — you read a process, tell whether it's any good, spot where AI creates value, and judge when to automate (and when not to), across the full revenue engine.
* Have fluency in modern GTM systems: Salesforce, marketing automation, enrichment, routing, attribution, lead\-to\-quote, billing or customer lifecycle tools. Deep Salesforce fluency is a strong plus.
* Have built with modern AI tooling: agents, plugins or skills on top of LLMs, connectors to business systems, and evals that tell you whether an agent is good.
* You define KPIs, run experiments, and use data to prioritize where to invest and to measure real impact on pipeline, conversion, efficiency and revenue.
* You drive strategic alignment and executive communication — conclusion first, tradeoffs named, complex topics made simple — and you drive change through to adoption.
* Thrive in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments where the first version of the strategy has to be shaped, tested and improved quickly.
* Run vendor evaluations end to end
* Set and hold standards for documentation, testing and deployment without slowing the team down, and coach senior ICs with care.
* Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR).

### **What We Offer**

* **Compensation:** Package includes base salary and a variable component
* **Benefits:** Work From Home allowance, social security, health insurance, unemployment insurance, common contingency, salary guarantee fund. Leave requests are subject to local policies.
* **Balance:** Flexible hours, Total work from home possible anywhere in Spain
* **Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S\+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact
* **Corporate Social Responsibility**: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate\-social\-responsibility\-charter
* **Culture:** A framework that will help you make an impact \- envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture: https://bit.ly/Convexity360L \& find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC ‍

* Call with the Talent Acquisition Manager


* Discovery Interview with the Hiring Coach (VP of Operations)


* Case Study with the Hiring Coach and future Team


* Clarification Interview with Future Direct Reports


* Convexity Culture Interview


* Offer!

title: Digital Product Owner – EMR & API Integration
description:
*At the Vitrolife Group, we work every day to unlock the full potential of science and technology to reduce the barriers towards building a family. Together we help our customers and their patients to fulfill the dream of having a baby.*

###### **We are looking for a** **Digital Product Owner – EMR \& API Integration** **to join our Customer Success Development team.**


Help shape how fertility clinics connect their EMR systems with Vitrolife's products and services—and make every day work simpler for the people supporting patients on their journey to parenthood.


Our vision is to create a connected, scalable integration experience that makes clinic onboarding and integration quick and easy, improves workflows in IVF clinics and within Vitrolife, and makes it simpler for clinics to work with Vitrolife products and services, including genetic testing, time\-lapse systems, and electronic witnessing solutions.

### **Summary**

We build and buy software that touches clinical trials, patient safety, manufacturing, quality systems and commercial operations. It now ships weekly rather than yearly, is increasingly AI\-assisted, and increasingly contains AI. Our control framework was built for a slower world.  

  

This role makes secure, compliant, audit\-ready software delivery the fastest path for engineers — not a gate they route around. You will own the enterprise SDLC governance model and build much of it yourself: policy as code, automated evidence capture, pipeline controls and reference architectures.  

  

This is a hands\-on, individual\-contributor leadership role. You will set enterprise direction, influence hundreds of engineers and lead through a federated community — but you will not have a large direct team, and you will spend meaningful time in repositories, pipelines and control code. Candidates seeking pure oversight or people management should not apply.
### **About the Role**

\#LI\-Hybrid  

Location: Barcelona, Spain

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the enterprise policy, standards and controls for software engineering, including source control, branching, peer review, testing, release management, environment segregation, change control, configuration and release documentation.
* Rationalise overlapping GxP, SOX, privacy, security and IT\-quality requirements into one coherent, risk\-based framework, ensuring low\-risk internal tools are not governed like regulated clinical systems.
* Retire SDLC controls that do not reduce risk and ensure tooling is implemented to securely speed up software development at Novartis at the highest scale, leveraging and creating AI tooling for the enterprise.
* Implement policy as code and controls as code, including branch protections, mandatory review, signed commits, segregation of duties, deployment approvals and immutable audit trails.
* Build automated, continuous evidence pipelines and define control telemetry including coverage, exceptions, drift, mean time to remediate and control effectiveness, with a focus on agility, automation and speed.
* Own secure\-by\-default guardrails in golden pipelines and paved\-road platforms, aligning with recognized frameworks including NIST SSDF, ISO/IEC 27001 and IEC 62304 where applicable.
* Define controls for AI\-assisted engineering, including acceptable use of coding assistants, agentic tooling, IP and licence exposure, provenance, attribution and human accountability for review and approval.
* Define controls for AI\-containing products, including model lifecycle, dataset and model documentation, evaluation, drift monitoring, explainability, human oversight and readiness for evolving regulatory requirements.
* Use AI to reduce compliance burden through automated risk assessment drafting, control mapping, test generation, deviation triage and documentation synthesis, while serving as technical authority for inspections, audits, certifications and SDLC remediation.
* Lead a federated community of engineering, quality, security and compliance practitioners, publish practical guidance, advise senior leaders on risk and trade\-offs, and partner with software developers across the enterprise to enable efficient delivery of compliant and secure products.

**Essential Requirement:**

* You are a practitioner. You have substantial hands\-on software engineering experience: you have written production code, owned CI/CD pipelines, and can read and modify pipeline configuration, IaC and policy code today, unaided. Expect a technical assessment.

* Credible technical judgement on AI in the SDLC — both the tooling and its governance implications.

**Desirable Requirement:**

* Experience in pharma, biotech, medical devices or another regulated industry (finance, aviation, nuclear), with real inspection or audit exposure.Experience with SOX ITGC in engineering contexts, IEC 62304 / SaMD, and privacy\-by\-design under GDPR.
* Hands\-on with modern stacks: Git\-based platforms and policy/protection features, container orchestration, cloud, IaC, policy engines (e.g. OPA/Rego or equivalent), test automation frameworks, SBOM and signing tooling.

### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Hardware Industrialization Specialist** , you will drive the end\-to\-end industrialization of new hardware components from design validation through series production, ensuring optimal balance between aesthetic excellence, strict timelines, cost efficiency, and technical reliability.  



### **Job responsibilities**

* Drive time\-to\-production targets and manage launch schedules
* Review and validate aesthetics with Design in alignment with industrialization constraints
* Manage testing processes (request, follow\-up, and validation) alongside suppliers and quality teams
* Conduct price negotiations, capacity analysis, and tooling/mould investments for production
* Optimize manufacturing methods for each launch to drive cost improvements
* Oversee pre\-series control, final approvals, master management, and PLM documentation
* Ensure system price updates and manage production risk analysis
* Provide technical expertise for root cause analysis and quality issue resolution
* Define, improve, and deploy technical standards across projects
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and countertyping analysis
* Build and maintain relationships with industry experts, staying abreast of new technologies, laboratories, and manufacturing advancements
### **Profile**

* 3 to 4 years of experience in a similar role managing development and/or purchasing for leather goods accessories, jewelry, or trimmings
* Degree in Industrial Engineering or Materials Engineering
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Proficiency in 3D modeling, rendering, and animation is a plus
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel), familiarity with AI tools, and fluency in various ERP systems
* Knowledge of PLM (Centric) software is a plus
* English proficiency (C1 or C2\) is mandatory; French, Chinese, or Italian is a plus
* Flexibility to travel to Europe and Asia
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

The Senior Coordinator, Housing and Student Services plays a key operational role in the delivery of student housing and student services in Madrid. The Senior Coordinator serves as a senior point of reference for housing\-related matters, helps ensure consistent service standards, and coordinates effectively with students, colleagues, landlords, residences, vendors, and other external partners.
