title: Sr. Manager, Global Packaging
description:
**Job Description:**

At NextPower, we lead the energy transition, providing intelligent solar trackers, power conversion, and control software solutions, together with strategic services that help our customers capture the full value of their solar power plants.  



  

As a company driving the clean energy transition, sustainability is central to our business and operations. Our worldwide teams are creative, collaborative and passionate problem\-solvers, driven by our mission to provide smarter energy solutions and support the transition to a more sustainable future.  



  

We are looking for a **Sr. Manager, Global Packaging Engineering** , based in **Madrid, Spain** , reporting to the **Sr. Director, Logistics Operations \& Packaging** .  



  

This role will lead our **Global Packaging Engineering function** , defining and implementing packaging strategy, standards and technical solutions across our global product portfolio. We are looking for someone who combines **strong technical packaging expertise with proven people leadership** and who is comfortable working both strategically and hands\-on.  



  

The position will work globally across Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, and our supplier network, with a particular focus on NPI, returnable packaging, standardization, sustainability, cost optimization, **and product protection** .  



  

### **What you will do**

* Develop and own the **Global Packaging Engineering strategy** , aligned with business priorities and focused on standardization, quality, sustainability, safety and cost optimization.
* Lead, develop and grow the **global Packaging Engineering team** , including capability development, resource allocation, performance management and common ways of working across regions.
* Represent Packaging Engineering in **NPI and new product development** , ensuring packaging requirements are considered from the early design stages through industrialization and launch.
* Lead the development and implementation of **returnable packaging programs** , including technical solutions, business cases, supplier implementation and operational deployment.
* Establish and maintain global **packaging standards, specifications, guidelines and validation requirements** across products, suppliers and regions.
* Drive packaging solutions for the full NextPower portfolio, including existing products, **new technologies and business verticals** , ensuring scalability as the company continues to grow.
* Work closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders to develop and validate packaging solutions, challenging existing designs and identifying opportunities for improvement.
* Drive **value engineering and cost\-reduction initiatives** , considering not only packaging cost but also container utilization, transportation, handling, warehousing, product damage and total landed cost.
* Partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Quality, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics and Operations to ensure packaging solutions meet technical, operational and customer requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement in packaging processes and technologies, identifying opportunities for **automation, standardization and sustainability** .
* Establish appropriate **KPIs and governance** to measure packaging performance, compliance, cost improvements, quality and returnable packaging effectiveness.
* Support packaging integration for **new products, technologies and acquired businesses** , establishing common standards and ways of working across the organization.
Maintain a hands\-on approach, including regular engagement with suppliers, manufacturing locations and project/customer sites globally.  
* 

  

### **What you'll need**

* **15\+ years of experience** in industrial Packaging Engineering, either within a manufacturing organization or packaging solutions provider.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in **Packaging Engineering** , Mechanical/Industrial Engineering with significant packaging specialization, or equivalent relevant technical background.
* Strong technical knowledge of **industrial packaging materials, design, specifications and validation** , including returnable and expendable/one\-way packaging solutions.
* Proven experience developing and implementing **returnable packaging programs** .
* Demonstrated **people\-management experience** , including leading and developing technical teams across different locations and time zones.
* Experience working in a **global manufacturing, automotive, energy or similar industrial environment** .
* Strong experience working cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics and suppliers.
* Ability to combine **strategic thinking with hands\-on execution** — we are looking for someone who can define the strategy but is also comfortable getting into the technical details when needed.
* Strong change\-management and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to challenge existing approaches and drive implementation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Fluent English.
* **Based in Madrid, Spain** , with willingness to travel globally to suppliers, manufacturing locations and project sites as required.

  

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

The successful candidate will help us build a stronger, more scalable Global Packaging Engineering organization, moving Packaging further upstream into product development while improving standardization, returnable solutions, quality, sustainability, and total landed cost across NextPower's global operations.  



  

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to shape how Packaging Engineering supports NextPower's continued growth, new products and business verticals.


At Nextpower, we are driving the global energy transition with an integrated clean energy technology platform that combines intelligent structural, electrical, and digital solutions for utility\-scale power plants. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data\-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure.


**We are Nextpower**
====================

title: Industrial Sustainability Specialist (Maternity Cover)
description:
### **Position**

Being part of LOEWE means learning every day alongside passionate teams in a fast\-paced, ambitious and creative environment.


As **Industrial Sustainability Specialist (maternity cover)** , you will support LOEWE’s industrial sustainability agenda, with a focus on traceability, raw material reporting, certified materials tracking and regulatory data management. Based in Getafe and reporting to the Industrial Head of Compliance, you will work closely with the Global Sustainability team, Business Units, IT, suppliers and external partners.  



### **Job responsibilities**

**Your role will include:**

**Reporting and data consolidation**

* Lead the consolidation, update and validation of raw material data for LVMH Cascade reporting, completing information manually when needed and coordinating any questionnaire or reporting changes with IT.
* Incorporate additional external data into the reporting process, including packaging and specific leather/material information not available in PLM or JDE.
* Prepare clear reporting summaries and presentations for internal governance forums, including COMEX.

**Traceability projects**

* Coordinate the implementation of traceability projects with TextileGenesis, suppliers, Business Units, IT and LVMH stakeholders.
* Manage operational activities such as Purchase Order uploads, supplier data monitoring, issue resolution, functional testing and API\-related business requirements.
* Prepare documentation and presentations for weekly IT meetings and Steering Committees, in coordination with TextileGenesis.

**Certified materials and sustainability tracking**

* Manage the collection, follow\-up and tracking of Transaction Certificates for certified materials, including supplier reminders and issue resolution.
* Maintain raw material dashboards and Power BI reports, periodically extracting and updating information from PLM to monitor sustainability progress.
* Coordinate with Business Units on certified materials, Life 360 goals, Pre\-Buy analysis and sustainability\-related inquiries.

**Regulatory and external platform management**

* Manage data collection, submissions and milestones related to Agec Law, Fairly Made and the French Environmental Score, ensuring alignment with collection launch deadlines.
* Coordinate with Fairly Made, internal teams, suppliers and Omnichannel to ensure accurate style/material data, follow up on missing information and support API or website\-related requirements.
### **Profile**

* Minimum of 5 years in the traceability and sustainability field, ideally in luxury goods, fashion or retail.
* Proven experience to coordinate project with IT team
* Proficiency in supply chain, material origins, traceability laws, certification standards and traceability (such as GRS, GOTS, CCS, OCS, FSC, PEFC, etc.).
* Proficiency in Power BI, Excel, and Power\-point. Power automate and PLM skills is a plus.
* Ability to lead in multi\-cultural settings and with multi\-cultural teams.
* Proactiveness and a self\-starter orientation: you are motivated by solving tough problems and proactively develop an action plan to tackling the work at hand
* Well\-organized, structured mind and good team player.
* Excellent fluency in English and Spanish. French is a plus.
* C\-level presentation skills.
### **Additional information**

**About LOEWE**

Founded in Spain in 1846, LOEWE is the second\-oldest luxury fashion house in the world. Since 2025, the House is under the creative direction of Jack McCollough and Lazaro Hernandez, guided by a rich artistic sensibility and an imaginative exploration of craft. This new chapter builds on core sensibilities of LOEWE: an intellectual and playful approach to fashion, the vibrant spirit of Spanish lifestyle, and unmatched leather expertise.


At LOEWE we are committed to a culture that welcomes all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic background and abilities, including people with disabilities of all types. Our aim is for everyone to feel valued, included, and empowered to contribute their best.


***LOEWE***
**MAISON**
----------------------

Steeped in art and historical references, rooted in craft and tradition, Loewe has been reinventing leather craftmanship for almost 200 years. From its birth in Madrid in 1846 to its latest collection dedicated to the elegance of Chinese monochrome ceramics, the Maison’s journey has been defined by its core values: energy, creativity, and a thoroughly modern approach blended with traditional techniques.
  

Craft at Loewe is unconditionally bound up with art, an endless source of inspiration: from the British Arts \& Craft masters to the whimsical world of Studio Ghibli, art is at the heart of every collection – and the House is committed to supporting the artists and creators informing its work.
  

Today, Loewe’s master artisans combine their craft knowledge, accumulated over generations, with new technologies to produce iconic objects presenting both instant appeal and enduring style: true incarnations of Loewe’s ideals and vision.
  

Radical and ever\-evolving: here’s to another 200 years of Loewe history
  

Since 2013, Jonathan Anderson, Loewe’s Creative Director, has been carrying this vision ever further. One of the leading designers of his generation, Anderson has spearheaded a major rejuvenation of the House.
  

Through a redesign of the brand identity, a modern articulation of its commitment to craft (with the launch of the Loewe Foundation Craft Prize, for instance), and a series of critically acclaimed and genre\-defining Women’s and Men’s collections, Loewe has been further elevated as an influential and global cultural force.
  

At the intersection of fashion, craft and culture, Loewe’s ambition is to be radical and ever\-evolving. Craft and luxury are inextricably linked, and at Loewe, the one makes the other feel more accessible and tangible. By showing how the collections are made and honouring the complex artisanal processes behind them, it becomes possible to see their value and their merit. And by adding a cultural dimension – involving fine arts, film, dance, etc. –, Loewe has become a vibrant force for creativity and innovation, ensuring the brand’s durability for another 200 years… and more.

title: Creator Network Lead (Contractor)
description:
Picsart's creator channel (agencies across the US, Asia, LatAm and Europe, thousands of active creators, tens of millions of views a week, and a creator program that pays for results) is something we want to make much bigger. You own the relationships and the execution: finding and signing agencies and creators, the agreements, getting content published, tracking what it drives, and deciding which partnerships to keep, grow or end.

  



You'll run a network the size of a department with a team of two. AI does what a team of ten used to: it builds the outreach lists, screens agencies and creators, scores every partner's performance and drafts the reporting. Data, Finance and Legal do their parts. You decide what the machine does and make the calls it can't. This is a role for someone who already works this way.

  



Please note that this is a **Full\-time Contractor (12 months)** role.


**How You'll Make an Impact**
-----------------------------


* **Find and sign partners.** Agencies and creators in every market that matters, working toward 50 agencies and 500,000 creators. You know where the good ones are and how to reach them.
* **Get the agreements done.** Terms, exclusivity, data access, rights and payment: in writing, on Picsart's terms, with Finance and Legal behind you.
* **Get campaigns published.** Live on time, in every market, at the volume agreed. Every post carries its link, its code and its creator, so nothing goes out untracked.
* **Track what each partner drives.** Signups, first generations, credits used, paying users and big spenders, in dashboards the Data team builds to your spec.
* **Decide who continues.** Recommend which partnerships to grow, hold or end based on what they convert, not what they view. Scale what repeats; cut what was lucky.
* **Grow revenue and usage.** 100x the revenue and AI credit use coming from the influencer and affiliate programs. Pay for results, never for views, and put the money behind what converts.
* **Build Picsart's own creator base.** Creators that agencies bring in end up on Picsart's terms, in Picsart's database, with a direct relationship, so agencies stay a choice, not a dependency.
* **Sell the network to partners.** AI model partners and brands already pay to run campaigns with our creators. Bring in more of that money so it covers a growing share of what the network costs.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------


* **Partnerships you've run at scale.** Creator, affiliate, UGC or influencer.
* **A network you grew from a handful to dozens.** You signed the partners that worked and ended the ones that didn't.
* **A head for numbers.** You can work out what a partner costs you per paying user, and whether they earn back what you pay them.
* **Judgment about what's real.** Results that came from a few individual creators aren't proof the model works, they're proof those creators work. You can tell which one you're looking at.
* **Negotiation that closes.** Terms, exclusivity, data, exit: signed, not agreed in principle.
* **A way of working that uses tools instead of headcount.** And you work well with Finance, Legal and Data without needing to be them.
* **Experience across markets is a big plus.** You know what wins in one country rarely copies to the next, and you're good at finding the local agency, operator or creator who can open a market you can't open yourself.
* **Great communication skills in English.** Any other languages are a plus.

description:
**Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware**

This role aligns to industry\-level titles such as Head of Product, Director of Product Management, Product Portfolio Director, or similar product leadership positions with responsibility for portfolio strategy, commercial performance, and team leadership.


**Role Overview**

The Lead, Product Management, ELL Institutional Courseware owns Pearson’s global portfolio of English language learning materials for schools, higher education and adult education. The portfolio spans print, blended and digital courseware, supplementary materials, teacher professional development, and partner\-created content.


This is an opportunity to shape the future of a major global education portfolio. The role will decide where Pearson invests, grows, localises, simplifies and exits, with accountability for creating products that teachers choose, improve student learning outcomes, and deliver sustainable revenue growth and strong returns.


A central part of the mandate is leading the evolution of a print\-heavy portfolio towards connected, digital and AI\-enabled learning experiences. Pearson intends to lead this transition while staying grounded in the needs and readiness of teachers and institutions.


The role owns the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and portfolio strategy through development, launch, performance management and retirement. It owns investment cases for approval by the ELL Leadership Team, recommends pricing and packaging, and drives initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.


The role leads a global team of approximately 15 colleagues through managers and works across Content, Learning Science, Engineering, Assessment, UX and AI. It is a member of the ELL Product Leadership Team and ELL Content Leadership Team, acting as the senior product owner for institutional courseware and aligning Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and Finance around a clear portfolio direction.


**Key Responsibilities**

**Set the Portfolio Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy and roadmap for institutional courseware, based on customer needs, market opportunities, learning outcomes, and commercial performance.
* Manage portfolio investments, prioritisation, localisation, innovation, and product lifecycle decisions.
* Act as the senior product authority, providing strategic recommendations to the ELL Leadership Team.

**Understand Customers and Markets**

* Build deep understanding of learners, educators, institutions, ministries, and partners across priority markets.
* Use customer insight, market trends, learning evidence, and performance data to drive product and investment decisions.
* Support strategic customer and ministry engagements alongside Sales teams.

**Create Market\-Winning Courseware**

* Translate strategy into compelling value propositions, product roadmaps, and requirements.
* Lead cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-impact learning solutions that balance customer value, learning effectiveness, quality, speed, and commercial outcomes.
* Validate opportunities through customer research, pilots, and data\-driven decision\-making.

**Lead the AI and Digital Transition**

* Drive the evolution from print\-first products to digital, blended, and AI\-enabled learning experiences.
* Identify and scale responsible AI opportunities that enhance learning, teaching, accessibility, and product efficiency.
* Ensure AI\-enabled products meet standards for transparency, safety, privacy, accessibility, and intellectual property compliance.

**Drive Growth and Investment Return**

* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, and investment recommendations for new and existing products.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations to achieve customer, learning, revenue, profitability, and ROI objectives.
* Take decisive action to optimise, reposition, or retire underperforming products.

**Measure Learning and Product Performance**

* Establish and monitor success metrics across learning outcomes, adoption, engagement, satisfaction, retention, revenue, and profitability.
* Use evidence and performance data to continuously improve portfolio effectiveness.

**Lead the Team and Organisation**

* Lead and develop a global team of approximately 15 product professionals.
* Foster excellence in product management, customer discovery, strategy, commercial thinking, and AI\-enabled product development.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and customer focus.

**Expected Results**

* A clear global portfolio strategy and roadmap, understood across ELL.
* Sustainable revenue growth, improved profitability and stronger returns from courseware investment.
* A simpler, more intentional portfolio with clear investment and retirement choices.
* Global products that combine scale with effective localisation.
* A credible transition towards digital and AI\-enabled courseware that customers can adopt successfully.
* Measurable improvements in student learning outcomes, teacher effectiveness and customer value.
* Trusted relationships with major institutions, ministries, distributors and partners.
* Strong alignment across Product, Content, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, Finance and Technology.
* A high\-performing global product management team with strong managers and clear accountability.

**Experience**

* Relevant experience in product management, portfolio leadership, general management or a related field, including experience leading multiple teams or managing managers.
* Proven success setting strategy and making investment choices across a complex portfolio of products, markets or customer segments.
* A track record of turning customer insight into differentiated products and successful commercial outcomes.
* Experience owning business cases and managing performance against revenue, profitability, customer and return expectations.
* Strong judgement across investment, prioritisation, pricing, packaging and portfolio rationalisation.
* Experience leading cross\-functional product development in a global, matrixed organisation.
* Experience building product teams and developing product leaders.
* Experience in education, publishing, courseware, EdTech or learning products is strongly preferred.
* Experience applying AI, data or emerging technology to products is preferred.
* No specific degree is required. Relevant experience and demonstrated outcomes are valued.

**Skills, Leadership \& Capabilities**

* Strong commercial and strategic acumen, with the ability to balance customer and learning outcomes with revenue, profitability, risk, and return.
* Proven expertise in product strategy, portfolio management, customer discovery, roadmap development, and stakeholder engagement.
* Data\- and evidence\-led decision maker, using customer insight, learning science, analytics, and sound judgement to shape investment and product decisions.
* Strong leadership capabilities, with experience leading global teams, influencing senior stakeholders, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. description:
Meta's mission is to give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. Through our family of apps and services, we're building a different kind of company that connects billions of people around the world, gives them ways to share what matters most to them, and helps bring people closer together. Whether we're creating new products or helping a small business expand its reach, people at Meta are builders at heart. Our global teams are constantly iterating, solving problems, and working together to empower people around the world to build community and connect in meaningful ways. Together, we can help people build stronger communities — we're just getting started.Meta seeks a motivated and organized team player to join our European Privacy and Data Policy team. You will work on strategic engagement and outreach with privacy and data policy stakeholders in the EU. This will involve working on cutting\-edge data policy issues and building relationships with key stakeholders. The role will involve proactive policy development, project management, and the creation of networks across different sectors. You will work in a fast\-paced, cross\-functional environment and present to both internal and external audiences. This role involves working on novel public policy issues. In this role you will combine substantive policy expertise with programme leadership: shaping and executing our external engagement strategy with regulators, policymakers, academics and civil society across the EU privacy and AI community, and translating the fast\-moving EU digital rulebook — GDPR, the AI Act, DSA, DMA, Data Act and the EU data strategy more broadly — into clear guidance and priorities for internal partners.The ideal candidate has a track record of public engagement (e.g., published thought leadership, conference speaking, or advisory roles) in the EU data and privacy community and is comfortable operating independently at senior levels both externally and internally. They will be detail\-oriented and strategic, able to adapt quickly, build credibility and trust across all levels of the organisation, and coordinate with cross\-functional leads on time\- and mission\-critical issues spanning policy, legal, communications, product, and engineering. This person will be highly organised, resilient and effective at prioritizing competing demands and delivering results in time\-sensitive scenarios and reports to the Director of Data and Privacy Policy, EMEA.  

  

  

### **Privacy and Data Policy Manager Responsibilities:**

* Policy leadership and external engagement
* Identify and monitor data policy issues affecting Meta in the EU
* Monitor, analyse and advise on EU and national developments in privacy, data governance and AI regulation, and assess implications for Meta's products and policy positions
* Develop proactive strategies and initiatives to address policy challenges
* Engage and build relationships with relevant stakeholders, with regulators, policymakers, academia, civil society and industry bodies in the country of hire and across the EU
* Represent Meta at meetings and conferences

* Programme and process management
* Own project plans and strategic planning frameworks for privacy and AI external engagement initiatives

* Drive escalated issues on priorities, goals, strategies, resourcing and key initiatives to resolution
* Partner with events and policy programmes teams to develop and execute event strategy
* Communications and knowledge management
* Shape internal communication strategies and channels on privacy and AI external engagement, in coordination with global counterparts
* Prepare briefing materials and presentations for senior audiences, including leadership policy and business updates on engagement and sentiment
* Build and run knowledge\-sharing processes for the engagement team, acting as subject matter expert for content and knowledge management best practices

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 6\+ years of professional experience in privacy, data or technology policy, regulatory affairs, or a closely related field
* Fluency in English and French, as the role requires direct engagement with French\-speaking regulators and policymakers in the EU
* Bachelor's degree or higher in a relevant fields
* Demonstrated expertise in AI policy and in the privacy and data protection framework of the EU digital landscape (GDPR, AI Act, DSA/DMA, Data Act)
* Established familiarity with and a network in the data and privacy community in at least one of the countries where the position may be based (Spain, France, Italy)
* Proven experience leading complex, cross\-functional programmes, including business process management, workflow and lifecycle management
* Strong presentation, writing, and stakeholder\-management skills, including those with senior external audiences

  

  

  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience advising product or engineering teams on regulatory requirements
* Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimise/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

* Additional official EU languages to support stakeholder engagement across EU member states

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Launched in 2013, WebBeds is a global marketplace for the travel trade, providing powerful distribution solutions that make selling and buying travel products easier. Hotels and other suppliers \- global and regional hotel chains, independent hotels, apartments, resorts, attractions, transfer and sightseeing companies and more \- can sell their products to a global network of online and offline travel buyers through robust solutions that provide greater inventory control to simplify distribution, and leverage WebBeds enhanced analytics to inform inventory optimisation choices – saving costs and increasing revenue.

We're Fever, the world's leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our results? We've teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award\-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?



To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar\-raisers with a hands\-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!  

  

Ready to be part of the experience?

Fever for Business (F4B) is our B2B organization, built around a simple idea: providing live experiences as a service to other businesses.



We help businesses, schools and global brands create memorable events without the usual complexity by providing a reliable, scalable, and high\-quality service.

As the HVAC Maintenance Technician in Diego Garcia, Serco\-NA, in conjunction with the United States Space Force (USSF) are responsible for tracking all man\-made objects in orbit. This mission is vital to keeping existing satellites safe and to provide critical information to organizations launching new satellites in the future. One of the assets USSF uses to accomplish this mission is the Ground\-Based Electro\-Optical Deep Space Surveillance (GEODSS) System.


This optical sensor is employed at three (3\) different locations around the world (White Sands Missile Range, New Mexico; Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory; and Maui, Hawaii) and helps track the objects in deep space orbit (altitude of 10,000 to 45,000 km).


Come join the team that provides this service to United States. You will help operate and maintain three (3\), one\-meter telescopes equipped with highly sensitive digital cameras. You’ll respond to Government tasking to obtain metric observations of specific objects daily and help maintain the sensors, support equipment, and the facility that houses it at Detachment 2, Naval Support Facility in Diego Garcia, British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT).

description:
**Job Description:**

**Ready to join one of our Airbus Programs in Spain?**  

  

AIRBUS offers an internship (curricular practicum) program aimed at students who are in the last year of their degree with the main objective of acquiring professional skills through the development of a project in the company.
  

  

**What do we offer?** **:**   

  

Internship (curricular practicum) program \+ Bachelor’s Degree Final Project (TFG).
  

  

**Mission:** You will prepare a final year training project that will allow you to complete your official studies.
  

  

**About practical training:**  



6 months of curricular practicum at AIRBUS from February to July 2027  

* 

  

Part time: 5h / day \- 25 hours per week (8h\-13h)  

* 

  

Tutor assignment for continuous monitoring  

* 

  

  

**Final project (TFG) to be carried out by the student:**  



* El objetivo de este TFG será el de realizar el diseño estructural de un vehículo no tripulado (UAV) para la posterior fabricación de una maqueta no funcional escalada del mismo.
* Para ello se utilizarán herramientas tipo CAD y de simulación FEM de cara a la reducción de peso, costes así como la simplificación de su ensamblaje. Una vez seleccionado el diseño final se llevará a cabo la fabricación de prototipos usando los medios existentes en ProtoSpace. Los materiales a usar podrán combinar el uso de metal, madera, impresión 3D y materiales compuestos. Para la fabricación del prototipo se contará con la ayuda de personal de taller cualificado. En el transcurso del proyecto se tendrán que realizar diferentes prototipos para validar los conceptos de montaje así como ensayos para evaluar su capacidad estructural.
* El primer paso será la evaluación de los requisitos así como el análisis de los riesgos y oportunidades del proyecto. Téngase en cuenta la distinta naturaleza de los requisitos (estructural, fatiga, fabricabilidad, etc.) así como la selección de los distintos medios de verificación de los mismos que se tendrán que aplicar. En la segunda etapa se realizarán estudios del diseño preliminar utilizando herramientas CAD.
* Posteriormente, se realizará el diseño en detalle junto con simulaciones FEM para validar el diseño y verificar el cumplimiento de los requisitos de integridad estructural. Durante esta etapa, se fabricarán prototipos para validar diferentes conceptos de diseño y montaje, siempre que sea necesario. Por último, se procederá con la fabricación de los componentes y ensamblaje de las diferentes partes, verificando durante el proceso los requisitos.Para realizar estos prototipos se introducirá al estudiante a las distintas técnicas de fabricación disponibles en protospace tales como el mecanizado, el corte por láser, el torneado, el corte por hilo caliente, la fabricación aditiva y la fabricación de materiales compuestos entre otros.
* Se pedirá al estudiante además que analice métodos de fabricación alternativos no disponibles en la actualidad en el departamento con el fin de incrementar el portafolio de medios de fabricación rápida disponibles. We are looking for a **Process Mining Consultant** to join a business process analysis and improvement project within an international corporate environment. The successful candidate will work with transactional data from SAP systems and other sources to reconstruct how processes are actually executed, generate process statistics and KPIs, and identify measurable improvement opportunities.


The objective of this role is to provide end\-to\-end visibility into processes such as **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, and Manufacturing**, translating analytical findings into actionable recommendations for business teams.

* Extract, model, and prepare event logs from SAP and other source systems.
* Build and configure analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence**.
* Reconstruct As\-Is processes and identify process variants, deviations, and rework.
* Calculate and monitor process KPIs and statistics, including throughput time, cycle time, waiting time, rework rate, automation rate, and conformance.
* Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and root causes, quantifying their operational and financial impact.
* Design dashboards and visualizations to support decision\-making.
* Present findings and improvement plans to business and IT stakeholders.
* Measure the impact of implemented actions and perform continuous follow\-up.
* Collaborate with SAP functional teams, data engineering teams, and process owners.

  

**Qualifications**

* 3\-5\+ years of experience in **Process Mining**, process analysis, or process intelligence.
* Hands\-on experience building analyses in **Celonis** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** (not limited to consuming existing dashboards).
* Strong SQL skills and experience in data modeling and data processing.
* Experience working with data from **SAP ECC** and/or **SAP S/4HANA**.
* Knowledge of at least one of the following end\-to\-end processes: **Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Supply Chain, or Manufacturing**.
* Ability to define KPIs and translate data analysis into business recommendations.
* Professional level of English to work in an international environment.

* Knowledge of SAP modules and tables, including **MM, SD, FI, PP, and WM**.
* **Celonis PQL** and/or **SAP Signavio Process Intelligence** certification.
* Experience with **Python**, ETL tools, or **Power BI**.
* Knowledge of **BPMN**, **Lean Six Sigma**, or continuous improvement methodologies.
* Previous experience in **FMCG**, food industry, or industrial environments.
* Knowledge of **SAP Activate** or **S/4HANA transformation programs**.

description:
**Our story:**
--------------


Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.


Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix, Steuerbot and TaxScouts, is a compassionate group of solution\-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3\.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016\.

  

**Your challenge:**
-------------------


We are seeking an experienced Senior Platform Security Engineer to design, implement, and maintain security solutions for our cloud\-native infrastructure and AI systems. This role will be responsible for securing our platform across multiple cloud environments, ensuring container and Kubernetes security, protecting AI/ML workflows, and implementing robust security controls throughout our SDLC. The ideal candidate will have deep technical and programmatic expertise in cloud\-native security, along with demonstrable hands\-on experience securing AI/ML systems.

  

**Your responsibilities and decisions:**
----------------------------------------


### **Cloud \& Infrastructure Security**

* Design and implement comprehensive security architectures for cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Implement security best practices for container and Kubernetes deployments
* Develop and maintain secure Infrastructure as Code (IaC) codebases
* Design and deploy zero\-trust network architecture and secure service mesh solutions
* Build and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines following DevSecOps principles

### **AI/ML Security**

* Secure AI\-powered product features end to end, covering context assembly, tool invocation, and output handling
* Design and review security controls for RAG implementations
* Secure agentic solutions and their extension points: tool integrations (MCP clients and servers), agent skills, and autonomous action boundaries such as scoped credentials, sandboxing, and human\-in\-the\-loop gates
* Build defenses against direct and indirect prompt injection and other adversarial inputs to LLM applications
* Establish data security controls for sensitive data flowing through inference, retrieval, and fine\-tuning

### **Security Operations**

* Lead incident response for cloud and AI infrastructure security incidents
* Develop and implement security monitoring and detection strategies

We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort\-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.
   

  

 We are seeking a hands\-on
 **Content Growth Manager** 
 to lead end\-to\-end asset production and distribution across the US region. You will leverage AI tools like Claude to prototype interactive features, manage freelance teams within budget, and optimize touchpoint analytics to ship three high\-value, revenue\-driving projects a month.
   

  

 What you will do:
   

  

* Ship monthly growth projects: Launch 3 end\-to\-end projects every month designed directly to drive user conversion and paid enrollments.
* Build interactive assets independently: Use AI tools like Claude to prototype custom calculators, skills reports, and pre\-payment checks without waiting on developers or designers.
* Source \& manage external talent: Find, hire, and direct freelancers, video editors, and contractors within budget to get projects across the finish line.
* Manage end\-to\-end distribution: Deploy and promote assets across all core growth channels, including the website, email marketing, social platforms, and sales collateral.
* Set up touchpoint analytics: Build robust attribution tracking to accurately measure content engagement, audience growth, and funnel drop\-offs.


 Requirements:
   

  

* Proven track record: A portfolio or case studies showing end\-to\-end projects you’ve personally built and shipped.
* Deep audience insight: Real understanding of US adult learners (ages 35–55\) and what content actually delivers value to them.
* AI fluency: Ability to build interactive tools independently using AI (like Claude) without relying on developers or designers.
* Resourceful execution: Experience sourcing contractors, negotiating budgets, and pulling resources together without waiting for assigned help.
* Fluent English (B2\+): Strong written and spoken communication tailored to a US market.


 What we can offer you:
   

  

* Competitive compensation: Market\-rate salary plus performance bonuses tied to project launches and enrollment metrics.
* 100% remote flexibility: Freedom to work from anywhere .
* Full tech \& AI stack access: Uncapped access to leading AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, low\-code builders) plus dedicated budget for freelancers and contractors.
* High autonomy, zero red tape: Complete freedom to test, vibe\-code, and ship projects without bureaucratic approval loops.
* Impact \& ownership: Direct influence on revenue and product strategy alongside a fast\-moving, high\-performing team.

title: Enterprise Account Director
description:
### **Position Overview:**



As an Account Director with Diligent, you'll be at the forefront of driving revenue growth, deepening customer engagement, and shaping the future of how businesses utilise our cutting\-edge solutions. Success in this role means expanding product adoption among current customers and introducing new clients to our platform. This is a high\-impact, individual contributor role that demands strategic vision, proactive relationship\-building, and relentless pursuit of excellence. You'll be responsible for everything from engaging prospects and managing a robust pipeline to delivering accurate forecasts and closing deals. Acting as a trusted advisor and strategist, you'll lead account planning, orchestrate internal collaboration, and leverage expertise to elevate customer success and revenue growth.



We're looking for a commercially sound sales professional with a track record of exceeding targets, a natural collaborator, and someone who thrives in fast\-paced, high\-growth environments. If you're driven to create value, embody a customer\-first ethos, and deliver innovative solutions, this is the role for you.



This role operates on a hybrid model, with 50% office\-based work required (periodic travel to partner offices will be required). This role is open to candidates based in London.



Regrettably we are unable to provide visa sponsorship, so you must be eligible to work in the UK.

  


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Proactively build a deep knowledge of and expertise in Diligent's products, solutions, strategy and business priorities.
* Responsible for prospecting new and existing business within the designated vertical / territory for complex accounts with longer sales cycles.
* Adopts a 'solutions' selling approach, understanding customer needs and developing solutions through the lens of the Diligent One Platform.
* Build deep relationships with prospects and customers during interactions by being customer\-focused and consistently honouring commitments and connecting the customer to internal commercial stakeholders to foster product growth.
* Develop and execute on account plans to ensure revenue targets, quota and customer business needs are met and collaborates with key stakeholders to drive integrated joint account wins for mutual business growth.
* Leads the coordination of Sales stakeholders to prioritise actions for multiple assigned accounts based on customer needs, sales generating importance, and account risks.
* Develops specialised business plans for customers that drive business outcomes to generate new business and upsells. Presents business plans to customers to generate new non\-qualified opportunities.
* Create and lead feedback loop processes with product management and product marketing to communicate and relay customer pain points and feedback.
* Demonstrate Sales excellence by managing the end\-to\-end sales cycle from opportunity to deal close using the Diligent approved sales methodology.
* Effectively utilise sales tools to prospect new leads, schedule initial meetings, increase win rates and generate bookings.
* Accurately maintain SFDC records, forecast and report out on projected bookings, deals closed etc. on a regular basis.
* Demonstrates a deep understanding of the competitor landscape externally, including customers' business strategy and the direction of the industry.

  


### **Required Experience/Skills:**


* 7\+ years of success in account management, new business acquisition, and exceeding revenue targets in a B2B SaaS environment
* 5 years of experience working with enterprise accounts
* The ability to build trust and influence senior leaders and stakeholders at all organisational levels
* A passion for continuous learning and a sharp understanding of both internal products and external industry trends
* Exceptional presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills that inspire confidence and drive outcomes
* A knack for aligning technology solutions with business objectives to deliver measurable value
* Self\-motivation, resilience, and a results\-driven approach to thrive in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment
* Fluency in English is essential

  


### **Preferred Experience/Skills**

* Experience using MEDDPICC or similar sales qualification methodologies to manage and progress complex B2B sales opportunities
* Experience of working within a GRC environment

  


**\#LI\-SK2**

**About Us**



Diligent is the AI leader in governance, risk and compliance (GRC) SaaS solutions, helping more than 1 million users and 700,000 board members to clarify risk and elevate governance. The Diligent One Platform gives practitioners, the C\-Suite and the board a consolidated view of their entire GRC practice so they can more effectively manage risk, build greater resilience and make better decisions, faster.



At Diligent, we're building the future with people who think boldly and move fast. Whether you're designing systems that leverage large language models or part of a team reimaging workflows with AI, you'll help us unlock entirely new ways of working and thinking. Curiosity is in our DNA, we look for individuals willing to ask the big questions and experiment fearlessly \- those who embrace change not as a challenge, but as an opportunity. The future belongs to those who keep learning, and we are building it together. At Diligent, you're not just building the future \- you're an agent of positive change, joining a global community on a mission to make an impact.

Learn more at diligent.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Facebook

  


**What Diligent Offers You**


* **Creativity is ingrained in our culture.** We are innovative collaborators by nature. We thrive in exploring how things can be differently both in our internal processes and to help our clients
* **We care about our people.** Diligent offers a flexible work environment, global days of service, comprehensive health benefits, meeting free days, generous time off policy and wellness programs to name a few
* **We have teams all over the world**. We may be headquartered in New York City, but we have office hubs in Washington D.C., Vancouver, London, Galway, Budapest, Munich, Bengaluru, Singapore, and Sydney.
* **Diversity is important to us.** Growing, maintaining and promoting a diverse team is a top priority for us. We foster and encourage diversity through our Employee Resource Groups and provide access to resources and education to support the education of our team, facilitate dialogue, and foster understanding.


Diligent created the modern governance movement. Our world\-changing idea is to empower leaders with the technology, insights and connections they need to drive greater impact and accountability – to lead with purpose. Our employees are passionate, smart, and creative people who not only want to help build the software company of the future, but who want to make the world a more sustainable, equitable and better place.



Headquartered in New York, Diligent has offices in Washington D.C., London, Galway, Budapest, Vancouver, Bengaluru, Munich, Singapore and Sydney. To foster strong collaboration and connection, this role will follow a hybrid work model. If you are within a commuting distance to one of our Diligent office locations, you will be expected to **work onsite at least 50% of the time.** We believe that in\-person engagement helps drive innovation, teamwork, and a strong sense of community.

  



Diligent is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Diligent's EEO Policy and US EEOC's Know Your Rights. description:
Hiive is redefining how private companies and their shareholders access liquidity. Through its institutional\-grade platform, Hiive brings together buyers, sellers, and issuers to facilitate secondary transactions in venture\-backed, pre\-IPO companies, introducing efficiency, transparency, and standardization to an otherwise opaque asset class.
   

  

 Recognized as one of Canada’s fastest\-growing companies and backed by leading U.S. investors, Hiive is profitable, well\-capitalized, and building a high\-performance team to meet growing demand and pursue new market opportunities.
   

  

 Interested in learning more about life at Hiive? Check out our careers page to see how you can grow with us!
   

  

 We are seeking a
 **Director of Product Design** 
 to own the user experience and interface design of the platform by recruiting and leading a team of in\-house product designers. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in shaping the user experience and driving innovation. This is a unique opportunity to create design excellence at a high\-growth startup and deliver experiences that make a meaningful impact on our customers and business.

* History of designing scalable user research and usability processes.

title: Principal Amazon PPC Specialist (Enterprise Brands, Seller Central)
description:
**Fuel the Growth of Enterprise Brands on Amazon!**  

  

**Role:** Principal Amazon PPC Specialist (Enterprise Brands, Seller Central)  

**Location:** San Diego, CA 92101 (Onsite at Symphony Towers)  

**Compensation Range:** $125,000\-$175,000 DOE  

  

Luminize is one of the top 5 Amazon sellers in the US. On most of our brands we buy the inventory ourselves. That changes the job: you are not optimizing to a ROAS target somebody else set, you are deciding what the ad spend should be when the margin is ours to protect.  

  

You will own **large enterprise brands and hundreds of thousands of dollars in monthly ad spend**. These are accounts where the escalation comes to you, and nobody above you is going to rebuild the campaign structure for you.

**What actually makes this a Principal seat, rather than a Senior one with a bigger book:**

* **You own enterprise accounts end to end.** Not "supported." Owned, including the escalations, the cross\-functional mess behind them, and the fix that stops them recurring.
* **You build things the rest of the org uses.** Toolsets, templates, playbooks for the entire department.
* **You develop other strategists.** You own SME and training content for up to three advertising functions, and you can point at a specific person and say what you taught them.
* **You reason in contribution margin, not just ROAS.** When we own the inventory, the right ad spend target is a different calculation. If that sentence is already obvious to you, we should talk.

**A normal week still includes** restructuring campaigns in Ad Console, pulling the Search Term Report, setting negation thresholds and defending them, and deciding where branded spend is worth it against organic rank. Roughly 60 to 70 percent of your week is heads\-down execution in platform.### **You may currently be a…**


Different companies title this job differently. If one of these is yours, you are in the right place:


Principal Amazon PPC Manager · Lead Amazon PPC Manager · Senior Amazon PPC Manager · Amazon Advertising Lead · Head of Amazon Advertising · Amazon Ads Team Lead · Retail Media Lead · Senior Retail Media Manager · Director of Retail Media (smaller agency) · Marketplace Advertising Lead · Senior Amazon Account Director · Paid Search Lead · Senior Paid Search Manager · Performance Marketing Lead (retail media) · Senior Amazon Brand Manager (if the ads are yours)

**One honest filter before you spend time applying:** this seat is Amazon sponsored advertising. If your Amazon experience is Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud or programmatic display only, with no hands\-on Sponsored Products or Sponsored Brands reps, this is not the right seat and we would rather say so now than at round four.

**A second honest filter:** if you have grown into a role where you direct analysts and no longer work in the console yourself, you will not enjoy this. Our strategist seats are hands on keys at every level, Principal included.  

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Lead Amazon PPC strategy and manage complex advertising campaigns
* Partner with enterprise clients, solving high\-impact challenges and delivering measurable results
* Analyze campaign data to craft insights and action plans that drive growth
* Mentor junior strategists and shape internal best practices
* Stay ahead of industry trends and leverage AI to optimize performance
* Design tools and templates that improve efficiency across the organization

  

✅ **What You Bring**

* **Hands\-on management of Amazon Sponsored Products or Sponsored Brands inside Ad Console within the last 12 months.** Hands\-on Google Ads or Microsoft Ads paid search also counts as a route in, though at this level we will expect the Amazon depth to be there.
* 8\+ years in advertising, 4\+ of them in Amazon PPC, with your most recent platform work no more than 18 months old
* **At least one named enterprise account you personally owned**, with the spend you controlled and a measurable thing you changed about it
* **Something you have built that other people adopted** \- a toolset, template, training module or playbook used beyond your immediate team
* Expert fluency in negation strategy, match types, harvesting rules and Top of Search modifiers, including your own click or spend threshold before you negate
* You lead with ACOS and TACOS unprompted, and you can reason about spend against contribution margin when the inventory is owned
* Real Excel or Sheets analysis \- you have built the model, not read someone else's
* You can run a high\-stakes enterprise client meeting and own an escalation in front of a stakeholder
* Able to work onsite in San Diego 5 days a week


### **➕ Nice to have, not required**

* Agency experience across a large book of business
* Perpetua, Helium 10 or similar tooling
* Walmart Connect, Instacart Ads or other retail media breadth
* Vendor Central depth alongside Seller Central
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, or the equivalent in experience


### **Your first 90 days**


Your first two weeks are training on our processes and meeting the people you will work with daily. Over the following 90 days you learn the Luminize advertising methodology by shadowing strategists on live accounts and working through real scenarios from our book. After one to two months you take on your first directly managed accounts with manager oversight, and you ramp toward a full book of enterprise brands.

### **Why We Are Onsite**


Because we own the inventory, an ad decision here is never only an ad decision. It touches what we bought, what is in stock, what the listing says and what the brand promised. At Principal, the accounts you own are the ones where those threads tangle worst, and the escalations land on you. The people who do this well are the ones who can walk to the brand manager's desk, get the answer in ninety seconds, and change the bid before the day closes. That loop does not survive a calendar invite.

**Relocating?** Relocation support is available for the right candidate, and we fly finalists in for their onsite. Raise it early and we will work it out with you rather than at the end.

 **Benefits \& Perks**


You do great work here and we want to take care of you outside of it, too.

* Comprehensive medical coverage, choose from multiple plans through Anthem Blue Cross
* Dental \& vision, including orthodontia and annual exams
* Pet benefits, savings on vet care, products, and services
* Paid Vacation, accrue 120 hours a year, with rollover
* Paid holidays and sick time
* 401(k) with company match, we invest in your future, too

  

**Compensation Transparency**


We’ve listed a broad salary range of $125,000\-$175,000/year to account for varying levels of experience, skill sets, and leadership depth. Where you land in the range will depend on how your background aligns with this role.


We are committed to compensating based on value and impact, not just years on paper, and we are happy to have open conversations throughout the process.

### **Symphony Towers, and an office you will actually want to be in**

* Panoramic city and coastline views from your workspace
* Free building gym access, no separate membership
* 24/7 paid downtown parking, blocks from the office, plus secure bike storage
* Exclusive discounts at tower restaurants and cafes
* Steps from 100\+ top\-rated bars, restaurants, coffee shops and Petco Park
* Ergonomic standing desks and premium workstations
* Fully stocked kitchen, snacks, espresso
* Monthly all\-company lunches, and a team lounge with a pool table for when you need twenty minutes away from a bid sheet


**Growth \& Career Opportunities at Luminize**


This is the senior individual contributor seat in advertising. From here the paths are advertising leadership, or going deeper as the person the department routes its hardest accounts to. We publish leveling guidelines, so you will know what each next step requires before you are asked to reach for it, and we have a strong track record of promoting from within.


You will also get cross\-functional exposure to content, brand management, software, supply chain, catalog and operations, plus Udemy course access and additional training.

  

**About Luminize**


Luminize is a full\-service Amazon growth partner helping brands achieve next\-level success in a competitive digital marketplace. From creative strategy to advertising and analytics, we combine expertise and hustle to fuel results for brands in CPG, health, wellness, beauty and beyond.


We are not your typical agency, and we like it that way. We operate with transparency, celebrate wins often, and treat every brand like it is our own.

**If you want a seat where the ad call and the margin call are the same call, apply!**


Luminize uses automated tools to help screen, rank, and filter applications as part of our hiring process. These tools assist our recruiting team by surfacing and organizing candidate information; final hiring decisions are made by our recruiters and hiring managers, not by the technology alone.


You have the right to opt out of the use of this technology in connection with your application. If you opt out, your application will be reviewed manually by a member of our recruiting team. You also have the right to request information about how this technology was used in connection with a decision about your application.


To opt out or to request more information, contact hiring@luminize.com. We will not retaliate against you for exercising these rights.

ABOUT THE JOB  

Working within Haymarket (Live Events)
Haymarket Business Media's Live Events team delivers a diverse portfolio of market\-leading awards, conferences and industry events across Haymarket Media Communications and Haymarket Professional brands. Bringing together professional communities through high\-quality live experiences, the team plays an important role in strengthening audience engagement, supporting commercial growth and enhancing the reputation of Haymarket's brands.


Working as part of the wider marketing function, the Senior Marketing Manager provides strategic leadership across an assigned portfolio of live events, developing and delivering integrated marketing strategies that drive audience engagement, delegate registrations, award entries and commercial performance across brands including Campaign, PR Week, Third Sector, Windpower and Planning. The role works closely with the Marketing Director and wider senior stakeholders, as well as cross\-functional teams including Events, Commercial, Editorial, Design and Data, to shape marketing strategy, identify opportunities for growth and ensure campaigns deliver against agreed audience and commercial objectives.

  

The Role* The Senior Marketing Manager will provide strategic leadership across an assigned portfolio of live events, ensuring marketing plans are aligned to audience, brand and commercial objectives.
* The role will oversee the development, delivery and optimisation of integrated marketing strategies, using data, audience insight and market trends to drive performance and identify opportunities for growth.
* Working closely with senior Commercial and Events stakeholders, the Senior Marketing Manager will ensure marketing activity supports audience acquisition, revenue generation and the wider commercial performance of the portfolio.
* The role will provide direction, coaching and support to Marketing Managers, Senior Marketing Executives and Marketing Executives, helping to build capability and ensure consistent standards across the team.
* As with all event\-focused roles, occasional evening attendance will be required to support the delivery of live events.


Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities  

* Lead the development and implementation of integrated marketing strategies across an assigned portfolio of conferences, awards and forums.
* Set clear marketing objectives, priorities and KPIs, ensuring activity is aligned with wider business and commercial goals.
* Provide strategic oversight of multi\-channel campaigns across email, social media, websites, digital advertising, partnerships and other relevant channels.
* Review campaign performance and audience insight, identifying trends, risks and opportunities and translating these into actionable recommendations.
* Work closely with senior Commercial stakeholders to develop marketing approaches that support delegate acquisition, sponsorship, partnerships and revenue objectives.
* Oversee marketing budgets across the assigned portfolio, ensuring resources are allocated effectively and activity delivers value against agreed objectives.
* Ensure effective use of customer data, audience segmentation and CRM capabilities to support targeted and measurable marketing activity.
* Provide strategic oversight of event websites, landing pages and digital customer journeys, ensuring they support audience engagement and conversion.
* Identify and implement new marketing approaches, channels and opportunities to improve audience engagement, campaign performance and customer experience.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Commercial, Editorial, Events, Design, Data, Production and Brand teams.
* Manage and develop relationships with external agencies, suppliers and partners, ensuring they deliver against agreed objectives and standards.
* Provide direction and oversight across campaign planning and delivery, ensuring key priorities, risks and dependencies are effectively managed.
* Lead, coach and develop Marketing Managers and more junior members of the marketing team, supporting individual development and building marketing capability.
* Support resource planning across the team, helping to ensure the right skills and capacity are available to deliver the events portfolio effectively.
* Contribute to the development of wider marketing strategy, processes and best practice across the Live Events function.
* Support the Head of Marketing / Marketing Director with wider departmental objectives, strategic projects and company\-wide KPIs.
* Attend and support live events as required, including occasional evening attendance.

  

Key Relationships
Builds strong and influential relationships with senior stakeholders across the Live Events business and wider Haymarket, including Commercial, Editorial, Events, Brand, Data, Production and Marketing teams.


Works collaboratively with senior colleagues and external agencies, suppliers and partners to develop and deliver effective marketing strategies and campaigns.


Provides leadership, coaching and direction to Marketing Managers, Senior Marketing Executives and Marketing Executives, supporting a collaborative, high\-performing marketing team.


Skills / Experience / Knowledge / Minimum Criteria:

Knowledge, Skills \& Experience  

Knowledge* Extensive knowledge of marketing principles, integrated campaign strategy and audience acquisition.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, customer journeys and data\-led marketing.
* Strong understanding of audience segmentation, CRM, customer data and campaign performance analysis.

title: Senior Copywriter, NIOD - Global
description:
**WHAT ON EARTH IS DECIEM?**



We are a collective of disrupters and doers, of creatives and scientists, with a mission to reimagine the world of beauty.


Since inception, our vertically integrated structure, including our own laboratories, manufacturing, retail stores, and brand infrastructure, have enabled us to rapidly identify opportunities and deliver quality. Home to The Ordinary, NIOD, AVESTAN, and other emerging brands, our goal is to create with purpose. We were founded on the principle of doing everything that others don’t. Because normal gets you nowhere.



We are DECIEM, The Abnormal Beauty Company.



We are growing rapidly and we’re looking for someone who shares this vision and wants to grow with us!


**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**


**We are looking for** a **Senior Copywriter** to join the DECIEM Design team as the dedicated creative partner for NIOD, operating as an agile, in\-house messaging authority within our global creative structure.



In this fast\-paced environment, you will lead 360° multi\-channel copy execution, including campaign concepts, product positioning, packaging text, digital assets, and visual merchandising layouts, while establishing specialized tone of voice guidelines (spanning the formal, the playful, and the beautifully abnormal) and a copywriting "center of excellence" to ensure global consistency across all customer\-facing touchpoints.



A critical requirement of this role is the advanced cognitive agility to decipher complex, scientific chemistry data and translate highly technical product formulations into precise, legally compliant, and consumer\-accessible narratives that balance strict regulatory standards with high\-end commercial appeal.


To qualify, candidates **must present a relevant portfolio alongside 5–7 years of copywriting** experience (preferably within an agency, startup, or fast\-growing consumer brand environment), impeccable grammatical precision, the operational maturity to incorporate cross\-functional stakeholder feedback seamlessly, and a distinctively sharp, intellectual sense of humor.

  

**WHAT YOU’D BE DOING IN THIS ROLE**


* **Lead 360° Campaign Copywriting:** Drive the creation of compelling copy for brand marketing campaigns, spanning campaign headlines, product messaging, social media, emails, and diverse branded materials.
* **Collaborate on Product Positioning:** Work in close creative partnership with the Brand team to build foundational concepts, unique selling propositions, and strategic product positioning.
* **Define Global Tone of Voice Guidelines:** Establish and execute clear copy guidelines for the business to ensure absolute tone consistency across all internal and external departments.
* **Build a Copywriting Center of Excellence:** Create a centralized hub of style guidelines and mastery for DECIEM brands, with a dedicated strategic focus on elevating DECIEM and NIOD.
* **Communicate Brand DNA:** Deeply understand and express the unique core DNA of our brands through creative copy on product packaging, marketing assets, and all customer\-facing touchpoints.
* **Drive Cross\-Functional Alignment:** Present conceptual copy and creative proposals directly to the VP of Brand, Creative Director, Art Director, and Head of Art \& Design for approval and collaborative development.
* **Decipher Complex Beauty Chemistry:** Masterfully absorb highly detailed, complex scientific chemistry data and translate it into accessible, engaging narrative text for the beauty consumer.
* **Manage Website Copy Development:** Support and oversee copy updates for DECIEM digital platforms and websites, ensuring every word perfectly aligns with the established brand voice.
* **Mentor and Align the Writing Team:** Act as a central communication link, keeping the wider copywriting network fully updated on any major brand direction shifts or strategic changes.
* **Ensure Editorial Quality and Agility:** Review ongoing internal and external communications for brand accuracy, managing multiple projects simultaneously with high responsibility, precision, and agility.


**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS NEEDED TO GET THE JOB DONE**


* **5–7\+ Years of Advanced Copywriting Experience:** Proven track record creating multi\-channel copy (social, digital, packaging, and internal/external communications), ideally within an agency, startup, or fast\-growing DTC consumer brand environment.
* **Versatile \& Strategic Storytelling:** Exceptional ability to write across a diverse spectrum of tones—from formal and highly intellectual to playful and beautifully abnormal—with a strong background in creative product concepting and positioning.
* **Scientific Communication \& Problem\-Solving:** A future\-thinking outlook with the unique ability to decipher complex, technical issues (such as detailed beauty chemistry) and translate them into crystal\-clear, engaging text.
* **Operational Excellence \& Agility:** Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and resolutive multi\-tasker who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, utilizes copy management systems, and takes full ownership to deliver projects flawlessly on time.
* **Impeccable Communication \& Cultural Alignment:** Outstanding written and verbal communication skills rooted in a relevant degree (English, Journalism, Copywriting) or equivalent experience, combined with absolute grammatical precision and a sharp, cheeky sense of humor.


**WHAT YOU’LL BE GAINING BY JOINING OUR TEAM**



There’s a lot of good stuff that comes along with being a DECIEM team member. Here’s a few of our favourite perks and benefits, in no particular order…


* Generous Vacation \& Personal Days, plus additional time off for volunteering in your community, voting, peaceful protesting, celebrating your birthday, and more.
* Work from anywhere 4 weeks per year.
* A hybrid work model (for applicable roles).
* Summer Friday’s \- get off at 1pm all summer long! (for applicable roles).
* Unlimited access to an Employee Assistance Program that includes mental health care, mindfulness programs, and more.
* Access to Development Grants \& a LinkedIn Learning membership to help you keep growing and learning.
* A generous discount on DECIEM products for you, your family, and your friends.

**BUILDING GROWTH TO POWER GOOD**



We are a People first company that lives by our core values to…


* ✨ Defy Convention.
* ✨ Make it real.
* ✨ Play in the grey.
* ✨ Build Bridges.
* ✨ Be the rabbit.



These values continue to guide us in all that we do. Along the way, we’ve been honoured to win some pretty incredible awards, including a CEW Achiever Award, Best Skincare Brand at Sunday Times Style Beauty Awards, and Most Popular Sustainable Brand by The Cosmetify Index Global. We’re still blushing!


**SUSTAINABILITY AND SOCIAL IMPACT**



DECIEM’s objective is to build growth and do good things while prioritizing people, animals, and the Earth.



Our Sustainability strategy is focused on fighting climate change, improved waste management, responsible packaging, responsible sourcing and product lifecycle, and water conservation.



In 2020, DECIEM established the Good Fund to support both large and grassroots charities in response to global events.

DECIEM is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) by creating meaningful, measurable change in the lives of our team members and in the communities where we operate. Working closely with local marketing teams, you will ensure global strategies are adapted appropriately to resonate with local consumers while maintaining alignment with brand standards and guidelines.
