title: Director of Creative, Luxury Hospitality
description:
**Luxury storyteller. Creative leader. Brand obsessive.**
 Luxury is felt long before it is booked. If you know how to create work that makes people stop, look twice and want to be there, this is a rare opportunity to do it on a global stage.
   

  

 Six Senses, Regent, InterContinental, Vignette Collection and Kimpton sit at the heart of the IHG Hotels \& Resorts Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio. Each has its own character, its own following and its own sense of place. As the portfolio grows, and as our Upper Luxury brands take centre stage, we are creating dedicated creative leadership to protect what makes each one distinctive and push the work further.
   

  

 As Creative Director, you will set the creative vision for our luxury and lifestyle brands and be the senior creative partner to the people who lead them. Your thinking will shape campaigns, content, hotel openings and guest moments, from the first image someone sees to the detail they notice on arrival.
   

  

 Reporting to the Head of Global Creative Services and based in Windsor, you will work across global and regional teams, with international travel part of the rhythm of the role.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Set and champion the creative vision for the Luxury \& Lifestyle portfolio, keeping every brand true to its own voice.
* Partner closely with brand, marketing and commercial leaders, bringing a clear point of view to the decisions that shape how we show up.
* Lead global multi\-channel campaigns and content that build desire and deliver commercially, across owned, earned and paid.
* Raise the bar on craft, from photography and film to design systems, experiential moments and digital.
* Mentor creative talent and get the best from our studio and agency partners.
* Shape how creative works at IHG, including where new technology and AI tools genuinely add something, without losing the human judgement behind great work.


**What You'll Bring**
* A career built in creative leadership, within luxury hospitality, luxury retail, travel, lifestyle or premium consumer brands.
* A portfolio that speaks for itself, with storytelling and visual craft at a level our guests would expect.
* A genuine point of view on modern luxury and what makes it feel current rather than expected.
* Confidence with senior leaders, and the presence to take them with you.
* Proven success leading integrated global campaigns across multiple markets.
* The instinct to lead multidisciplinary teams and agencies well, and to build something that scales.
* Experience with ultra\-premium or Upper Luxury brands is a real advantage, as is time spent on both agency and client side.


 If you want your work to live in some of the most beautiful hotels in the world, and to lead the creative story of a luxury portfolio in its next chapter, we would love to see it. Apply now.
   

  

*Closing date for applications Friday 2nd October 2026*
 At IHG Hotels \& Resorts, we work together to deliver True Hospitality for Good on a global scale. With corporate offices and over 6,000 hotel destinations worldwide, a career at IHG is the perfect way to broaden your horizons. You’ll experience our unique culture and brilliant colleagues who will support and inspire you. With a host of corporate opportunities to choose from, wherever you are on your career journey, and whatever you want to achieve there’s Room for You at IHG.
   

  

 Over recent years, we’ve transformed our company. We have bold ambitions to drive performance and maintain our relentless focus on growth in order to be the hotel company of choice that guests \& owners love.
   

  

 We are a hospitality business at our core and value connections and being together helps us foster a unique sense of belonging that also supports productivity. That’s why here at IHG, we give our colleagues flexibility and balance – working in a hybrid way, blending office and remote working collectively. We recognise that every role is different, that’s why leaders work with teams to determine how and when they collaborate.
   

  

 We provide a wide range of benefits designed to help you live your best work life. These include impressive room discounts across our many properties, recharge days and volunteering days throughout the year. Through our myWellbeing framework, we are committed to supporting wellbeing in your health, lifestyle, and workplace. We offer a unique and inclusive culture, where there is always Room for You to belong, grow and make a difference.
   

  

 Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams where we celebrate difference and encourage colleagues to bring their whole selves to work. IHG Hotels \& Resorts provides equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other category protected by applicable laws. We promote a culture of trust, support, and acceptance. Always welcoming different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
   

  

 Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Brand Manager
description:

**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you passionate about premium skincare, innovative marketing, and making a real impact on brand growth? Join our dynamic team as a
 **Brand Manager for Filorga** 
 !
   

  

 In this role, you will be the key driver of local marketing execution, bridging global vision with impactful local activations. You will collaborate closely with our global team in France to adapt international brand guidelines and bring high\-profile launches, events, and campaigns to life across local markets. From orchestrating major medical congresses and Filorga Days to managing a robust digital and influencer strategy, you will shape how our brand connects with healthcare professionals, influencers, and consumers!
   

  

 If you thrive in an inclusive, courageous, and caring environment where your strategic creativity and data\-driven mindset can shine, we would love to welcome you to our team!
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
* Global Lineage \& Local Execution: Partner closely with international teams to localize innovation strategies, brand positioning, and product launches effectively.
* Events \& Congress Activation: Define and execute the strategy for key brand events, Filorga Days, medical congresses, and in\-clinic activations—determining the optimal timing, format, and channels to drive brand engagement.
* Digital \& Social Media Strategy: Lead organic and digital social media presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Collaborate with digital teams and agencies to produce engaging, high\-quality content aligned with business objectives.
* Analytics \& Performance Tracking: Monitor, analyze, and optimize digital performance metrics (ROI, CTR, conversion rates, views) to identify high\-performing channels, including organic medical influencer partnerships.
* Budget \& Resource Management: Oversee a significant marketing budget, ensuring optimal allocation and measurable return on investment across all campaigns and events.
* End\-to\-End Campaign \& Inventory Coordination: Work in tandem with Sales and Logistics to manage event materials, sampling strategy, promotional items, and product inventory required for events and activations.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner across internal teams (Sales, Digital Commerce, PR, Supply Chain) and manage external agency relationships to ensure seamless execution and consistent brand messaging.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Completed Bachelor’s degree.
* 5\+ years of experience in brand management, marketing execution, or social media/influencer strategy.
* Demonstrated experience in the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG/CPG), skincare, beauty, or skin health sectors.
* Strong proficiency in social media platforms and analytics tools (e.g., Meta Insights, TikTok Analytics, Google Analytics, Emplifi, or similar).
* Proven experience managing large marketing budgets and driving ROI\-focused campaigns.
* Availability and willingness to travel nationally and internationally.
* Advanced project management, analytical, and cross\-functional communication skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master’s degree or MBA.
* Experience adapting global brand guidelines to local markets.
* Expertise in working with medical/dermatology influencers, healthcare professionals, or specialized congresses.
* Proven track record in public relations, agency management, and high\-impact brand partnerships.
* Demonstrated commitment to working collaboratively in a diverse, equitable, and inclusive team culture.

 Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

description:
We are looking for a Director, Product Management – Search \& Match to shape and drive our core algorithm, ranking, discovery, and recommendation product strategies. Reporting to the VP of AI \& Platform Products, you will act as a key product and business partner, translating complex data systems into high\-impact executive narratives, commercial growth levers, and seamless marketplace experiences. This role requires an experienced leader who blends strong business sense with high\-impact executive presentation skills to align senior stakeholders, optimize platform resource allocation, and lead cross\-functional product teams.



Search \& Match is the core intelligence engine powering our platform's two\-sided marketplace. It drives both sides of the matching equation: enabling job seekers to discover relevant roles (B2C) and helping employers and recruiters surface qualified candidates and resumes (B2B). These intelligent discovery mechanics directly power overall engagement, retention, and enterprise platform adoption.


**About this team**



Our mission is to provide the best\-in\-class job search tools that drive the best outcomes for job seekers and provide long term value for our brand. This team works cross\-functionally with Engineering, Analytics, Marketing, Design, and Finance to achieve business goals.


**What you'll do**

Shape and Drive Two\-Sided Marketplace Strategy


* Align Strategy to Business Impact: Define and own the multi\-year strategy and roadmap for Search \& Match, directly linking algorithmic advancements to core business outcomes, enterprise customer value, and job seeker engagement.
* Dual\-Sided Marketplace Discovery: Drive search, ranking, and recommendation strategies across both consumer\-facing search (job seekers discovering opportunities) and B2B search mechanics (employers and sourcers searching resume databases and candidate pipelines).
* Resource \& ROI Stewardship: Govern functional team capacity, compute/infrastructure investments, and feature prioritization—balancing trade\-offs between performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
* Market \& Competitive Positioning: Evaluate industry trends in search, vector embeddings, and machine learning to position our dual\-sided matching engine as a premier market differentiator.


Executive Influence \& Stakeholder Alignment


* Executive Storytelling \& Presentation: Translate complex search performance, algorithmic models, and marketplace dynamics into clear, compelling narratives and board\-ready presentations for executive leadership.
* Build Cross\-Functional Coalitions: Drive strategic consensus across Engineering, Data Science, UX, Enterprise GTM, and Consumer Operations—ensuring alignment on roadmap sequencing and operational trade\-offs.
* Lead Through Change: Guide functional teams through strategic pivots, shifting organizational priorities, and technology evolutions with structured rationale and strong clarity.


Drive Operational Excellence \& Execution


* Orchestrate Execution at Scale: Lead cross\-functional product squads across match scoring, candidate indexing, search relevance, and recommendation feeds to ensure predictable, high\-velocity delivery.
* Systems \& Marketplace Metrics: Establish clear performance metrics to measure search precision, recall, candidate\-to\-job match relevance, search latency, and reciprocal marketplace liquidity.
* Culture of Experimentation: Oversee rigorous A/B testing and experimentation protocols to continuously refine discovery algorithms for both candidate and recruiter touchpoints.


Build and Develop High\-Performing Teams


* Mentorship \& Talent Pipeline: Coach and develop Product Managers, instilling strong business sense, strategic thinking, user empathy, and executive communication skills.
* Evolve Product Rituals: Establish operational frameworks, governance rituals, and decision\-making standards that foster velocity and transparency across teams.


**What you'll need**


* 8–10\+ years of experience in product management, with significant experience leading two\-sided marketplaces, search engines, recommendation systems, or match platforms.
* Proven Executive Presence: Exceptional presentation and storytelling abilities—able to influence executive leadership, translate complex technical topics into business impact, and drive organizational consensus.
* Strong Business Sense: Deep commercial intuition with the ability to connect algorithmic performance (relevance, precision, candidate conversion) directly to platform health and client retention.
* Two\-Sided Marketplace Expertise: Proven track record of balancing dual stakeholder needs—solving for both B2C consumer discovery and B2B enterprise/recruiter search workflows.
* Strategic \& Resource Allocation Mastery: Experience shaping functional product strategies, managing engineering trade\-offs, and maximizing investment ROI without direct P\&L management.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: Skilled at building trust and alignment across matrixed organizations, including Data Science, Machine Learning, UX, and Commercial teams.
* People Management Experience: Demonstrated success coaching, mentoring, and leading product managers to drive team growth and operational excellence.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical, quantitative, or business field (or equivalent practical experience).


**What's good to have**

* Direct experience presenting strategic roadmaps and performance insights to C\-suite executives and board members.
* Background in recruitment technology, two\-sided talent marketplaces, resume indexing systems, or professional networking platforms.
* Familiarity with modern AI/ML search paradigms, Large Language Models (LLMs) for semantic matching, or vector search technologies.

description:

----------------

  

Case Western Reserve University is committed to providing a transparent estimate of the salary range available for this position at the time of its posting. The salary range is between $52,705 and $66,672, depending on qualifications, experience, department budgets, and industry data.


Employees receive more than just a paycheck. University employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that includes excellent healthcare, retirement plans, tuition assistance, paid time off, and a winter recess.


**Job Description**
-------------------

  

POSITION OBJECTIVE


Working under general direction, but with a high degree of independence, the Campus and Community Engagement Manager is responsible for providing leadership across the organization in the development and implementation of all engagement and outreach strategies to include intellectual and innovative events, publications, and programs. The manager works to build awareness of Kelvin Smith Library¿s services, collections, and programs and to enhance outreach beyond the campus community. The manager works collaboratively with all library teams and actively engages with colleagues across the campus to determine needs and integrate that information into customized programs and events.

  

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* Develop strategies and facilitate a comprehensive and integrated campus and community relations program with measurable objectives to review and evaluate the success of engagement strategies. (20%)


* Supervise and mentor the Outreach and Engagement coordinator to include clear goal setting, regular feedback, and strong support for growth. Consider professional development opportunities annually and initiate and complete regular individual check\-ins and performance reviews. (15%)


* Work collaboratively with library staff, faculty, and student groups to offer and coordinate services to enhance visibility and accurately project the key messages and image of the Kelvin Smith Library¿s educational and research mission. Coordinate activities and foster relationships among stakeholders and staff to ensure awareness about current and emerging library activities and so messages are consistent, timely, and effective. (8%)


* Leads the planning and execution of large special events and works in partnership with the Exhibitions and Programming librarian. (7%)


* Work with library leadership to determine appropriate strategies for outreach and engagement priorities both internally and externally, and maintain knowledge of academic library issues, actions, and plans. (7%)


* Cultivate a work environment that promotes and maintains an environment and culture of empathy, collaboration, and respect. (6%)


* Plan, administer, and monitor program budgets. (6%)


* Implement effective project management and assessment strategies and develop short\- and long\-term goals. (6%)


* Develop an annual event and media calendar to outline plans for specific activities and events to build awareness and avoid overlap. (6%)


* Develop strategies, guidelines and training for staff to advance effective engagement with the academic community and the general public. (6%)


* Work with library staff and campus development staff to develop library case statements and increase awareness within the donor community about recent developments at the library and opportunities for giving. (6%)


* Serve as the primary liaison between the library and University Marketing and Communications to ensure effective information flow. (6%)

  

NONESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS


* Perform other duties as assigned. (1%)

  

CONTACTS


Department: Frequent contact with the Director, Administrative Services on policy and procedural issues, practices, and strategies. Contact with the vice provost and university librarian, associate university librarians, relevant coordinators, committees, and department heads to gain support for engagement and outreach concepts and receive approval. Contact with the Research Services and Engagement Librarians to facilitate collaboration on various library programs, services, resources, etc.


Continuous contact with the Outreach and Engagement Coordinator.


University: Regular contact with University Marketing and Communications staff to ensure distribution of press materials to promote the library on campus, local, regional and national media to raise local visibility of library events and programs. Occasional contact with related departments on campus (including Admissions, Alumni Engagement, Annual Giving, and Student Affairs) to implement activities and programs to attract and retain students and donors.


External: Occasional interaction with community partners (Cleveland, East Cleveland and surrounding areas) for developing and implementing programs and events.


Students: Moderate contact with students working at the library and students studying at the library.

  

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES


This position has one nonexempt direct report, Outreach and Engagement Coordinator; as well as oversees student employees that assist with marketing and outreach communications.

  

QUALIFICATIONS


Experience: 3 or more years of related work experience in outreach and engagement.


Education: Bachelor's degree

  

REQUIRED SKILLS


* Creative, goal\-oriented, and enthusiastic individual with excellent planning and organizational skills.


* Demonstrated excellent communication, interpersonal, and customer service skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in all forms, across all platforms, and with different audiences.


* Ability to manage multiple projects effectively, and to partner with key personnel throughout the organization.


* Possess good judgment, tact, discretion, and diplomacy. Ability to maintain confidentiality.


* Experience with supervising and mentoring staff including clear goal setting, regular feedback, and strong support for growth.


* Proactive approach to potential problems, excellent problem\-solving skills required.


* Collaborative, flexible, and agile with the ability to interact effectively with colleagues, supervisors, and customers in both virtual and in\-person environments.


* Ability to cultivate an environment of empathy, collaboration, and respect.


* Prefer demonstrated design skills, including technical proficiency using software for desktop publishing and graphic design and illustration. Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite preferred (particularly InDesign, Illustrator, and Photoshop) and Canva.


* Willingness to learn and work with artificial intelligence (AI) tools and technologies.


* Ability to demonstrate successful support, education, and advocacy for all students, aligned with the values, mission, and messaging of the university, while adhering to the staff policy on conflict of commitment and interest.


* Ability to meet consistent attendance.


* Ability to interact with colleagues, supervisors, and customers face to face.

General office/library environment. Some projects may involve prolonged viewing of a computer screen and sitting for extended periods of time. * Challenge the status quo and drive continuous improvement
* Demand excellence from themselves and their colleagues
* Identify and solve problems others don't even recognize
* Create innovative solutions others believe impossible



  





 We deliberately seek these rare, high\-impact performers who attract similar talent. While most companies avoid hiring these exceptional individuals due to their demanding nature, we actively pursue them. When we find someone extraordinary, we move quickly to bring them onboard.
 



  





 We believe average talent builds average companies. By assembling a team of exceptional performers, we're creating the talent density needed to transform the rental industry and set new standards of excellence.

Mission Inbox is the infrastructure layer for B2B email at scale.  Our Team is distributed all over the world, we welcome talent, no matter their geography, ethnicity or religion.

**Demand Generation \& Paid Media** 
 Own paid acquisition across LinkedIn, Google, and relevant niche channels. Build and iterate on audience targeting, creative, and bidding strategy — no agency dependency. Define and hit a monthly pipeline contribution target. Manage budget allocation across channels based on CAC and payback period data.
   

  

**Organic Content Engine** 
 Build a consistent content operation: blog, LinkedIn, newsletter, thought leadership. Develop and execute an SEO strategy targeting deliverability, cold email, and outbound infrastructure keywords. Write or directly manage 80%\+ of content output in the first 12 months.

 Own the Mission Inbox website end\-to\-end: messaging, structure, and conversion performance. Run continuous CRO experiments across landing pages, CTAs, pricing page, and sign\-up flow. Implement and maintain tracking, attribution, and analytics infrastructure.

**Webinars \& Events** 
 Launch and run a recurring webinar program targeting B2B sales leaders, RevOps, and agency operators. Identify and manage presence at relevant industry events. Build event follow\-up nurture workflows that convert attendance to pipeline.

 Design and execute multi\-touch nurture programs for MQLs, trial users, and churned accounts. Build behavioral email workflows triggered by product activity and sales signals. Own HubSpot (or equivalent) — setup, segmentation, automation, and reporting.

\* Interpret fashion sketches, reference images, and creative direction and translate them into technically feasible garments.

\* Construct complete garments from first sample through final piece.

\* Perform both machine sewing and high\-quality hand sewing.

\* Apply couture finishing techniques, including invisible hems, hand finishing, internal finishing, delicate closures, and clean seam construction.

\* Understand garment structure, balance, fit, proportion, and movement.

\* Conduct fittings and make necessary pattern and garment adjustments.

\* Develop solutions for internal garment support, boning, lining, interfacing, corsetry, and structured areas when required.

\* Work carefully with complex draping, bias\-cut garments, layered fabrics, and intricate silhouettes.

\* Ensure every garment meets a very high standard of craftsmanship, fit, and finishing.

\* Recommend appropriate construction methods based on the design and selected fabric.

\* Minimize fabric waste while maintaining accurate cutting and quality.

\* Maintain organized patterns, samples, and garment\-development records.

\* Work closely with the Creative Director to develop and refine each design while maintaining the original creative vision.

Required Experience \& Skills

\* Strong professional experience in couture, bridal, eveningwear, luxury womenswear, or high\-end bespoke fashion.

\* Advanced pattern\-making skills.

\* Advanced draping skills.

\* Excellent fabric\-cutting ability.

\* Excellent machine\-sewing and hand\-sewing skills.

\* Strong understanding of garment construction and couture finishing.

\* Ability to work with delicate, expensive, and difficult fabrics.

\* Strong knowledge of women’s garment fitting and alterations.

\* Ability to understand a sketch and independently determine how the garment should be constructed.

\* Experience creating samples and prototypes from the development stage through the final garment.

\* Excellent attention to detail and precision.

\* Strong problem\-solving skills when translating creative designs into wearable garments.

\* Ability to work independently and manage several designs during collection development.

Preferred

\* Experience working in a couture atelier, bridal house, luxury fashion house, or bespoke studio.

\* Experience with evening gowns, draped dresses, corsetry, and complex silhouettes.

\* Knowledge of embroidery, embellishment, fabric manipulation, and hand\-applied details is an advantage.

\* Experience developing garments from original designer sketches rather than only following existing patterns.

We are specifically looking for someone who is not limited to one technical area. The candidate should be capable of managing the complete garment\-development process:

Sketch → Draping / Pattern Making → Toile → Fitting → Pattern Correction → Cutting → Sewing → Couture Finishing → Final Garment

title: Senior Director, Content Design
description:
**Company Description**  

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.


Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**  

The Head of Content Design will lead the content design function across ServiceNow’s digital products and platforms. This role requires a visionary leader who can shape the way content enhances the user experience, drives customer engagement, and supports the overall product goals. As a senior leader in the organization, you will collaborate closely with other leaders across Product, UX, AI, and Engineering teams to ensure content is clear, consistent, and aligned with the needs of users. You will be responsible for developing and executing a content design strategy that supports the company's mission and business objectives.

* Lead and mentor a team of content designers to define how natural language, both written and spoken, shapes enterprise workflow experiences. Work closely with product designers across AI\-native products (Now Assist, Agent builders, Agentic workflows) and traditional UI to establish content design as a core discipline in product development. Own the strategy and execution of content design, ensuring it's integrated early and continuously throughout the design process.
* Establish content design standards and best practices that span both UI content and conversational flows, ensuring consistency across the ServiceNow platform while respecting the distinct design patterns of dialogue, tone, and turn\-taking in conversational AI.
* Develop scalable frameworks for content design across the design org. Partner with DesignOps to operationalize content design through both direct team capacity and by enabling UX designers across business units to author effective conversational and UI content.
* Conduct user research in partnership with UX Research and Product to measure how content clarity and conversational naturalness drive user comprehension, trust, and task completion in enterprise AI workflows.
* Own the full content and conversation lifecycle from discovery through design, deployment, and continuous learning based on user behavior and feedback. Build feedback loops from production usage into iteration.
* Define and track OKRs that measure content design impact: user comprehension, task success rates, conversational relevance, and platform consistency metrics.
* Communicate content strategy to executive leadership and build alignment across UX, Product, and Engineering on the role of language in driving ServiceNow's competitive advantage in AI\-native product experiences.
* Build and develop a high\-performing, cross\-functional team. Foster a culture of craft, experiment, and continuous learning in conversational and content design.
* Partner with DesignOps to define team structure, investment model, and capability\-building. Scale both your direct team and the broader design org's ability to own conversational design.

 **Qualifications**  

To be successful in this role you have:

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, HCI, Information Design, or related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in content strategy and UX writing, 3 in the AI space, with a focus on software applications and AI technologies.
* Proven leadership in managing content and growing a content design organization.
* Strong understanding of user research, analytics, and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and interpersonal skills.
* Track record of leading content initiatives for complex digital products at scale.
* Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with content management systems, design tools, and analytics platforms.
* Passion for creating user\-centered content that drives engagement.
* A plus: Willing to be a strong voice in the external content design community.

title: Director, Brand & Integrated Marketing
description:
The Director of Brand \& Integrated Marketing will own MeUndies’ overall brand strategy and translate it into a cohesive marketing calendar, compelling campaigns, culturally relevant content, and consistent execution across every customer touchpoint. This leader will oversee the Brand and Social teams while owning integrated campaign planning, product\-launch briefing, content strategy, influencer and affiliate strategy, licensing marketing, and brand partnerships. This is not a role for someone who only develops high\-level strategy or manages agencies. We are looking for a hands\-on leader who can set the vision, write a strong brief, lead teams through execution, make decisions quickly, and measure what worked.
   

  

 This role will work closely with Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, Wholesale, and Licensing to ensure the entire organization is working from one clear brand and commercial calendar.
   

  

****Please note that this is a hybrid position of 4 days/week in our Los Angeles office.****
**What You'll Do**
* Brand Strategy and Positioning
* Own and evolve the MeUndies brand strategy, positioning, voice, visual identity, and cultural point of view.
* Ensure the brand remains distinctive, relevant, emotionally resonant, and consistent across DTC, retail, wholesale, and licensed products.
* Translate company and commercial priorities into clear customer\-facing narratives.
* Maintain and evolve brand guidelines while ensuring teams and external partners apply them consistently.
* Protect long\-term brand equity while helping the company achieve near\-term revenue goals.


 Integrated Marketing Calendar
   

  

* Own the master MeUndies marketing calendar across product launches, promotions, seasonal moments, collaborations, licensing, retail, and cultural opportunities.
* Create one source of truth connecting Brand, Creative, Growth, Retention, E\-commerce, Merchandising, Product, and Wholesale.
* Lead cross\-functional planning meetings and ensure teams understand the objective, audience, message, deliverables, owners, deadlines, and success metrics for every major initiative.
* Identify calendar conflicts, missed opportunities, and resource constraints early.


 Campaigns and Product Launches
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end go\-to\-market process for major campaigns, product launches, collaborations, and licensed collections.
* Develop sharp, actionable briefs grounded in customer insight, business goals, channel needs, and a clear creative proposition.
* Ensure briefs include the audience, insight, objective, positioning, key message, deliverables, channel strategy, timing, budget, and measurement plan.
* Partner with Creative to develop concepts that are both brand\-building and commercially effective.
* Maintain launch readiness and hold cross\-functional teams accountable to deadlines and deliverables.


 Content and Social Strategy
   

  

* Own the integrated content strategy across organic social, campaigns, editorial, community, creators, partnerships, and emerging channels.
* Lead the Social team and establish clear channel roles, content pillars, publishing cadence, and platform\-specific strategies.
* Build a content engine that allows MeUndies to respond quickly to cultural moments without losing brand consistency.
* Balance polished campaign content with creator\-led, community\-driven, educational, entertaining, and conversion\-oriented content.
* Establish a disciplined testing and learning process for formats, messages, talent, and platforms.


 Influencer, Creator, and Affiliate Strategy
   

  

* Own the strategy for influencers, creators, ambassadors, affiliates, and other external brand advocates.
* Develop a clear approach to seeding, paid partnerships, long\-term creator relationships, performance affiliates, and brand ambassadors.
* Build programs that generate both culturally relevant content and measurable customer acquisition.
* Partner with Growth to define channel economics, attribution, testing budgets, and performance expectations.
* Identify creators and partners who authentically represent the MeUndies customer and brand values.


 Licensing, Collaborations, and Partnerships
   

  

* Lead the marketing strategy for entertainment licenses, collaborations, and strategic brand partnerships.
* Partner with Product, Merchandising, Creative, Legal, and licensors from concept through launch.
* Develop a balanced licensing calendar that can drive customer acquisition and revenue without overwhelming the core MeUndies brand.
* Identify new collaboration and partnership opportunities that expand cultural relevance, audience reach, and commercial potential.
* Ensure all licensed marketing meets partner requirements while still feeling unmistakably MeUndies.


 Consumer Insights and Cultural Relevance
   

  

* Build a strong understanding of the MeUndies customer through research, social listening, reviews, community feedback, competitive analysis, and performance data.
* Translate customer and cultural insights into actionable campaign, product, and content opportunities.
* Track cultural shifts, category trends, emerging platforms, and competitor activity.
* Serve as the internal voice of the customer and help teams understand what is changing in the market.


 Brand Communications and Community
   

  

* Partner with internal and external resources on PR, earned media, founder communications, events, and brand reputation.
* Develop strategies that deepen customer participation, advocacy, and community.
* Identify opportunities for experiential marketing, events, pop\-ups, and earned cultural moments.
* Help shape how MeUndies responds to sensitive cultural, customer, or reputational issues.


 Measurement and Hindsights
   

  

* Establish clear success metrics before every campaign and launch.
* Lead formal post\-launch hindsights that assess creative performance, channel performance, customer response, operational execution, and commercial results.
* Turn findings into specific changes for future campaigns instead of simply reporting results.
* Develop a brand\-health measurement framework covering awareness, consideration, sentiment, engagement, customer growth, and brand relevance.
* Partner with Growth and Finance to understand incrementality, return on marketing investment, and the relationship between brand activity and revenue.


 Leadership and Operations
   

  

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable the Brand and Social teams.
* Build clear workflows, decision rights, timelines, and standards for excellent execution.
* Manage relevant agencies, freelancers, creators, production partners, and brand budgets.
* Prioritize resources across competing initiatives and maintain a high bar for quality, speed, and accountability.
* Present strategies, plans, results, and recommendations to senior leadership.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* MeUndies operates from one clear and reliable integrated marketing calendar.
* Every major launch begins with a strong brief, launches on time, and concludes with a useful hindsight.
* The brand has a more recognizable and culturally relevant point of view.
* Social and content become more consistent, responsive, and commercially effective.
* Influencer and affiliate programs have clear strategies, economics, and measurement.
* Licensing and collaborations support both revenue growth and long\-term brand equity.
* Cross\-functional teams have clearer priorities, ownership, and deadlines.
* Brand investment is measured with the same discipline as performance marketing.


**What You Have**
* 8–12\+ years of brand, integrated marketing, or consumer marketing experience, ideally within a modern DTC, apparel, lifestyle, beauty, or consumer brand.
* Experience leading brand strategy and integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
* Demonstrated success building marketing calendars and launching products, collaborations, or licensed collections.
* Strong understanding of organic social, creators, influencers, affiliates, partnerships, and content development.
* Ability to connect brand\-building activity with commercial performance.
* Excellent briefing, storytelling, presentation, and written communication skills.
* Strong understanding of consumer insights, cultural trends, and modern customer behavior.
* Experience managing teams, agencies, budgets, and complex cross\-functional projects.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with high expectations and limited bureaucracy.
* Willingness to work at both the strategic and executional levels.


**The base salary range for this full\-time position is $125,000\-$150,000\. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the base salary range provided in this posting does not include any bonus, equity, or benefits you may be eligible for.**
****WHY WORK AT MEUNDIES?****
****It's more than a job.****
 We have focused on building a team of people who emulate our core values. We look for people who stay balanced, go further, build relationships, champion differences, and are humble. At MeUndies, we continue to maintain a stellar brand by working collaboratively and encouraging growth with learning opportunities. There is no such thing as a small achievement here \- we celebrate it all!
   

  

****We look at the necessities.****
 We offer competitive salary packages, including targeted annual bonuses, generous parental leave, a 401k, fantastic health benefits, open time off, and more.
   

  

****We have an office you’ll enjoy going to.****
 We work in our office Monday \- Thursday. Friday is a remote/work\-from\-home day. We’re set up to support comfortable working \- hot desks, lounge, and casual seating areas, a Mother’s Room, an on\-site gym \& shower, and a kitchen that makes you feel like you’ve never left home. We’re dog\-friendly, so your furry coworker can join you anytime.
   

  

****We don’t forget the most important things.****
 We want MeUndies to be a place where you feel safe and comfortable, and we encourage our employees to hold us accountable for keeping it that way. We encourage open communication and a People Ops team that is ready to help. When you work at MeUndies, we take your needs as an employee (and a person) seriously. Our doors are always welcome to feedback and suggestions!
   

  

****Plus those special extra things.****
 We also know how important it is to connect with your team members outside of everyday work. We offer catered lunches every in\-office day, holiday parties, off\-sites, happy hours, and an annual retreat. You’ll also get a sweet employee discount to rebuild your underwear drawer with our top\-notch prints.

In addition, MeUndies will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable federal, state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.**

**Director of Brand Marketing** 




  





**Location:** 
 Irvington, NY

 Full\-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 a.m.–5:30 p.m.

 Four days in office, one day remote

 Electric Picks is a rapidly growing jewelry brand known for trend\-forward styles, meaningful storytelling, and a lifetime guarantee. We’re entering an exciting new chapter and looking for a Director of Brand Marketing who can help define what the brand becomes next.

* Build scalable workflows and planning tools that improve clarity, accountability, and execution.

* Strong cross\-functional leadership skills and experience partnering with Creative, Growth, Digital, PR, Product, and Commercial teams.
* Experience managing and developing high\-performing team members.
* Excellent communication, organization, and stakeholder\-management skills.

* A creative thinker with strong taste, cultural curiosity, and a distinct point of view.

* A clear and thoughtful communicator who brings people together around a shared vision.
* A low\-ego, high\-EQ collaborator who knows when to lead, support, and execute.
* A mentor who raises the quality of thinking and execution across the team.



  





**Why Electric Picks** 




  





 You’ll join Electric Picks at a pivotal moment, with the opportunity to influence the brand’s long\-term vision while making an immediate impact. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, lead high\-visibility initiatives, and help build the campaigns, experiences, team, and operating foundation that support our next stage of growth.
